# S15. Patient Detail Screen

> **Existing HMIS screen.** Most HMIS already have this screen. Do not rebuild it: add only what NHCX needs (the fields and actions marked for NHCX below, such as ABHA number and address, HPR id, registration and qualification) to the target's own screen, and record anything else as `found` in discovery.

#### S15R. ROUTE
patients/view/:id

Optional query parameter: `tab`, one of `overview`, `encounters`, `problems`, `lab`, `billing`. It picks the open tab. Anything else opens Overview.

Breadcrumb: Patients (patients/list, S13) > <patient name>

Page title: the patient's full name.

#### S15D. DESCRIPTION
The patient chart. A header banner identifies the patient, and five tabs hold the record: Overview, Encounters, Problems & allergies, Laboratory and Billing.

A patient id that does not exist shows "Patient could not be found." with a "Back to dashboard" button.

Header banner:
- Avatar, then the full name (a link back to this screen).
- A row of chips: MRN (info), gender in title case, age ("47 y" or "age unknown"), blood group (danger colour, only when recorded), and "ABHA <number>" (success colour, only when recorded).
- The mobile number with a phone icon.
- On the right: "Edit" (pencil icon), "New OPD visit" (primary, stethoscope icon), "Admit" (secondary, bed icon).

Tab 1, Overview:
- A card of label and value pairs in three columns: MRN (chip), ABHA number, ABHA address, Gender, Date of birth, Age, Mobile, Email, Marital status, Blood group, Address (address line, city, district, state and PIN joined by commas, blanks skipped), Emergency contact (name, relationship and phone joined by commas).
- Below it, the Vitals card:
  - Snapshot of the latest set: "Last recorded <when> · <encounter number>", or "· recorded on the chart" when that set is not tied to a visit. Then one tile per vital that has a reading: short name, value, unit, and a flag chip when the value is outside the reference range (High in danger, Low in warning, Normal in success). With no vitals: "No vitals recorded yet."
  - Accordion item "Record a new set of vitals". Open by default only when no vitals exist. Holds one number input (step 0.1) per vital, labelled "<name> (<unit>)" with help text "LOINC <code>" and the reference range as placeholder. The vitals are Body temperature (Cel), Heart rate (/min), Respiratory rate (/min), Systolic blood pressure (mm[Hg]), Diastolic blood pressure (mm[Hg]), Oxygen saturation in Arterial blood by Pulse oximetry (%), Body weight (kg), Body height (cm), Body mass index (kg/m2). Then "Taken at" (date and time, defaults to now), "Attach to encounter" (dropdown of up to the 25 latest encounters as "<number> · <OPD/IPD> · <when>", blank option "Not linked to a visit", defaults to the newest open encounter; help text "Only vitals attached to an encounter enter that encounter's FHIR document."), "Note" (text), and the button "Record vitals" (primary, heart-pulse icon).
  - Accordion item "History - <n> recording(s)": a table with columns Taken at, Encounter (link to the visit, or "-"), then one column per vital. Missing readings show "-". Out of range values carry their flag chip. Empty state: "No vitals recorded yet."

Tab 2, Encounters:
- Card titled "<n> encounter(s)" with actions "New OPD visit" (primary, stethoscope icon) and "Admit" (bed icon).
- Columns: Number (link to the OPD visit or IPD admission), Type (chip: OPD in info, IPD in warning), When, Doctor, Department, Status (colour chip).
- Newest first. Empty state: "No encounters recorded, start an OPD visit or admit the patient."

Tab 3, Problems & allergies:
- Problem list card titled "Problem list - <n> entr(y/ies)".
  - Columns: Problem, ICD-10, SNOMED CT, Type (chip "diagnosis" or "history"), Status, Source (link to the encounter it came from, or "-"), Recorded (date), and a "Remove" button.
  - Shows diagnoses recorded on visits and chart-level medical history. Chart-level entries come first. "Remove" appears only on chart-level history entries, and asks "Remove "<problem>" from the problem list?" before it fires.
  - Empty state: "No problems recorded. Chart-level problems flow into the Medical history section of every document."
  - Accordion item "Add a problem" (open by default only when the list is empty): "Problem (SNOMED CT + ICD-10)" dropdown (options "<display> (<code>)", blank option "Free text only"), "Description" (text), "Clinical status" dropdown (Active, Recurrence, Remission, Resolved, Inactive; default Active), "Onset" (date), "Attach to encounter" (blank option "Chart-level (appears in every document)"), "Note" (text), and the button "Add to problem list" (primary, plus icon).
- Allergies card titled "Allergies - <n> recorded".
  - When any allergy is high risk, a red banner first: "High risk allergy: <names>".
  - Columns: Allergen, SNOMED CT (code, or "text only"), Category, Criticality (chip: "high risk" danger, "low risk" success, "unassessed" warning, or "-"), Reaction, Status, Recorded (date), and a "Remove" button that asks "Remove the recorded allergy to <allergen>?".
  - High risk allergies sort first.
  - Empty state: "No allergies recorded. Entries here populate the Allergies section of the OP consult and discharge summary documents."
  - Accordion item "Add an allergy" (open by default only when the list is empty): "Allergen (SNOMED CT)" dropdown (blank option "Free text only"; help text "AllergyIntolerance.code is mandatory and SNOMED-coded in the NRCES profile."), "Description" (text), "Category" (Medication, Food, Environment, Biologic; blank option "From the allergen"), "Criticality" (Low risk, High risk, Unable to assess; blank option "Not assessed"), "Reaction (SNOMED CT)" (blank option "None"), "Reaction detail" (text), "Noted during encounter" (blank option "Chart-level (appears in every document)"), and the button "Add allergy" (primary, alert icon).

Tab 4, Laboratory:
- Card titled "<n> lab order(s)" with action "Order investigation" (primary, flask icon).
- Columns: Order (link to the lab order), Panel, Ordered, Status. Empty state: "No lab orders for this patient."

Tab 5, Billing:
- Card titled "<n> invoice(s) · ₹ <sum of invoice totals>" with action "Raise invoice" (primary, rupee receipt icon).
- Columns: Invoice (link to the invoice), Type, Date, Amount ("₹ 0.00", right aligned), Status. Empty state: "No invoices raised."

Messages after the POST actions (the screen reloads on the relevant tab):

| Action | Endpoint | Returns to tab | Success | Failure |
| Record vitals | `POST patients/:id/vitals` | Overview | "Recorded <n> vital sign(s)." | "Enter at least one reading." when every reading is blank |
| Add problem | `POST patients/:id/problems` | Problems & allergies | "Problem added." | "a problem needs either a coded diagnosis or a description" |
| Remove problem | `POST patients/:id/problems/:problemid/delete` | Problems & allergies | "Problem removed." | Only chart-level entries can be removed |
| Add allergy | `POST patients/:id/allergies` | Problems & allergies | "Allergy recorded." | "an allergy needs either a coded allergen or a description" |
| Remove allergy | `POST patients/:id/allergies/:allergyid/delete` | Problems & allergies | "Allergy removed." | |

Behaviour worth keeping:
- Blank vital inputs are skipped. Values outside the reference range are flagged High or Low. BMI is derived from weight and height when not entered.
- A new problem is saved as medical history. A coded pick fills the SNOMED and ICD-10 codes and its display wins over the typed description.
- A new allergy takes the typed description, or the allergen's display if none was typed. Category falls back to the allergen's own category. Status is saved as active.

Claims: two actions in the header, beside "Admit": **"Search insurance policy"** opens the policy search [S1. Search Policy](S1-search-policy.md) prefilled with the patient's ABHA number (else the mobile number; the desk may switch to Member ID) and carries the patient through [S2. Select Policy](S2-select-policy.md), so the case opens linked to this patient (the case-opening API already takes `patient`); **"Claims"** opens the claim list [S5. Claim Master](S5-claim-master.md) filtered to this patient's cases. The admission is still linked on the Claim Creation Form S4, and the claim screens (S4, S6) link back here by the patient's name.

NHCX use: the header's ABHA chip is the quickest check that the patient can be matched to a policy. The IPD admissions in the Encounters tab are what a claim links to. The diagnoses recorded on that admission and its consultant become the pre-authorisation's diagnoses and treating doctor, so a diagnosis added to the admission (it shows here with that admission as Source) is what the payer sees.

- Add and record forms live inside accordions under their tables, with the submit button right aligned.
- Remove buttons are extra small, danger style, and confirm in a browser dialog.

#### S15A. ACTIONS
1. Edit: go to the Patient Registration Form S14 in edit mode for this patient.
2. New OPD visit (header or Encounters tab): open the new OPD visit form with this patient preselected.
3. Admit (header or Encounters tab): open the new IPD admission form with this patient preselected. That admission is what S4 links a claim to.
4. Switch tab: show the chosen tab. The open tab can also be set with `?tab=`.
5. Record vitals: post the readings, then reload S15 on the Overview tab with the result message.
6. Add to problem list: post the problem, then reload S15 on the Problems & allergies tab.
7. Remove (problem): confirm, delete the chart-level entry, then reload on the Problems & allergies tab.
8. Add allergy: post the allergy, then reload on the Problems & allergies tab.
9. Remove (allergy): confirm, delete, then reload on the Problems & allergies tab.
10. Encounter number or Source link: open that OPD visit or IPD admission.
11. Order investigation: open the new lab order form for this patient. Order number links open the lab order.
12. Raise invoice: open the new invoice form for this patient. Invoice number links open the invoice.

> **Existing HMIS screen.** Most HMIS already have this screen. Do not rebuild it: add only what NHCX needs (the fields and actions marked for NHCX below, such as ABHA number and address, HPR id, registration and qualification) to the target's own screen, and record anything else as `found` in discovery.

practitioners/list

#### S16D. DESCRIPTION
The master list of the hospital's doctors. Every practitioner that can be picked on a visit, an admission, an invoice or a claim's care team is set up here. Practitioners are never deleted, because their names sit on encounters, prescriptions and reports. They are retired instead, and a retired practitioner drops out of every picker.

List:
- Ordered active first, then by department, then by name. Retired practitioners stay in the list.
- Card title: "<n> practitioner(s)".

| Column | Content |
| Name | Practitioner name |
| Department | Department, or "-" |
| Qualification | Qualification as typed, or "-" |
| Identifier | Identifier type code and number, for example "HPID 71-1234-5678-9012" |

| Name | Text | `name` | Required |
| Department | Dropdown, blank option "Not stated" | `department` | General Medicine, Cardiology, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Dermatology, Emergency, Gastroenterology, Nephrology, General Surgery. |

# A19. ABHA Create and Verify (ABDM M1)

#### A19E. ENDPOINT
Not an NHCX exchange: ABDM's ABHA service, called **from the application's server**, never from the operator's browser. The server carries the ABDM session token from [G3. #### A19D. DESCRIPTION
The ABHA number is what links a claim to an admission ([S4. Claim Creation Form](../screens/S4-claim-creation-form.md), [D3. patient](../database/D3-patient.md)), and under PMJAY it is the account the beneficiary is authenticated against ([A18. Biometric Authentication](A18-biometric-authentication.md)). A number typed at the desk is a number nobody checked. This API puts a **verified** ABHA on the file, two ways, and fills the file from what the ABHA service says about the person: name, gender, date of birth, mobile, ABHA number and address.

**Verify an existing ABHA.** By its number, or by the mobile it is registered against. The identifier is sealed under the service's certificate and sent with `scope ["abha-login", "mobile-verify"]`, `loginHint` `abha-number` or `mobile`, `otpSystem abdm`; the OTP goes to the mobile either way. Verifying the OTP by ABHA number answers the account and the X-token directly, and the profile is read with it. Verifying by mobile answers the accounts on that mobile (a shared family phone holds several) and a short-lived T-token: the desk picks the account, `verify/user` with the chosen `ABHANumber` a

**Create an ABHA from an Aadhaar OTP.** With the person present and their consent recorded (consent code `abha-enrollment`, version `1.4`): the Aadhaar number sealed as `loginId` with `scope ["abha-enrol"]`, `loginHint aadhaar`, `otpSystem aadhaar`; the OTP goes to the mobile registered against the Aadhaar, which may not be the phone in the room. `enrol/byAadhaar` with the sealed OTP, the communication mobile and the consent answers `ABHAProfile`, the tokens and **`isNew`**: an Aadhaar that already has an ABHA returns that account with `isNew` false, so read it before telling anyone something 

Rules, both ways:
- The Aadhaar number, the OTP and the identifiers are sealed **in the page** under the certificate from `/profile/public/certificate` (RSA/ECB/OAEPWithSHA-1AndMGF1Padding, base64; WebCrypto's `RSA-OAEP` with `SHA-1` on an `spki` import of the key; the server hands the certificate to the page and caches it for an hour). The server passes the sealed values through to the service and never stores or logs them; the audit event for the OTP step carries the last four digits of an Aadhaar at most.
- The session token, the X-token and the T-token stay **on the server**, keyed by the flow's `txnId` and the signed-in user, for fifteen minutes; none of them is ever sent to the browser, and the page holds only `txn_id`. The gateway session token is never sent as an X-token; the server refreshes it through [G3. Session Token](../gateway/G3-session-token.md) when the service answers 401.
- The profile written onto the file: `abha_number` (14 digits, shown as `xx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx`), `abha_address` (the preferred address, else the first `phrAddress`), `name` (`name`, else first, middle and last), `gender` (`M` `F` `O` to Male, Female, Other), `birth_date` (`dob` as `DD-MM-YYYY`, or day, month and year), `phone` (left blank when the service masks it as `******0903`). A blank field on the form is filled; a typed one is kept.
- A person already on the register under that ABHA is opened, not registered again; the register's unique ABHA refuses a second file anyway ([D3. patient](../database/D3-patient.md)).

Refused before any call: "An Aadhaar number has 12 digits.", "Ask for the OTP first.", "Enter the OTP that was sent.", "A mobile number has 10 digits.", "An ABHA number has 14 digits.", "Enter the ABHA number, or the mobile it is registered against.", "An ABHA address is 8 to 18 letters, digits, dots or underscores.", "Choose one of the accounts listed.", and on a lapsed login: "The login has lapsed; ask for the OTP again."

A refusal from the service is shown in its words: the `error.code` and `error.message` block, else the field it named invalid. Every call failing the same way is a session or header problem (`everything-returns-401` on the MCP).

#### A19Q. REQUEST

The application's endpoints, behind the session, one per step of the flow; each makes the service call named in A19E **on the server** and answers the page only what the next step needs. The page never sees a token.

| Endpoint | Body | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| `GET abha/certificate` | | `public_key` (the service's certificate, for the page to seal with), `expires_at` |
| `POST abha/enrol/otp`, `/enrol/verify`, `GET abha/enrol/suggestions`, `POST abha/enrol/address`, `POST abha/login/otp`, `/login/verify`, `/login/select` | the function's inputs below, sealed values as sealed by the page | the function's answer below, never a token |

Each step writes one audit line (`enrol_otp_sent`, `enrolled`, `address_set`, `login_otp_sent`, `login_verified`, `login_selected`) on the server; the page cannot write the trail.

The server's ABHA client, which the endpoints call, exposes the flow as these functions; each makes the service call named in A19E.

| Function | Takes | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| `enrolOtp` | `aadhaar`; `txn_id` to resend | `txn_id`, `message` (the masked mobile the OTP went to) |
| `enrolVerify` | `txn_id`, `otp`, `mobile` (optional) | `txn_id`, `is_new`, `profile`, `message` |
| `suggestions` | `txn_id` | `addresses` |
| `enrolAddress` | `txn_id`, `abha_address` (with or without `@sbx` or `@abdm`) | `abha_no`, `abha_address` |
| `loginOtp` | `abha_no` or `mobile` | `txn_id`, `message`, `hint` (`abha-number` or `mobile`) |
| `loginVerify` | `txn_id`, `otp` | `txn_id`, `hint`, `accounts`; by number also `profile` |
| `loginSelect` | `txn_id`, `abha_no` | `profile` |
| `seal` (page side) | a value | the value sealed under the service's certificate (from `GET abha/certificate`), for every identifier and OTP above and for the face authentication's Aadhaar ([A18. Biometric Authentication](A18-biometric-authentication.md)) |

`profile`: `{abha_no, abha_address, name, gender, dob, mobile, status}`. `accounts`: `[{abha_no, name, abha_address, status}]`.

    detail = ""

"""Shared service helpers (SCAFFOLDING 3.3, 8; APIs conventions).

Every outbound service (A2 to A8) uses these. Names are stable:

Errors
- ``ServiceRefusal(message)``: a refusal shown to the desk verbatim
  (the API answers ``400 {"ok": false, "error": message}``).

Sending (APIs conventions "SEND")
- ``send(path, envelope, claim, *, label="") -> Ack``: refuses inside a DB
  transaction, archives the outbound envelope and its acknowledgement, logs
  with the case number, correlation id and ledger id. A ``SendError`` that
  names ids, or a result with ``ok`` false, comes back as an ``Ack`` with
  ``failed`` set to the message to store; a ``SendError`` naming no ids (or an
  unconfigured gateway) raises ``ServiceRefusal`` since nothing went out.
- ``Ack``: txn_id, correlation_id, request_id, api_call_id, ledger_id,
  headers, response, failed (str or None).
- ``headers(claim, workflow_id, *, sender=None, status=None, extra=None)``:
  the x-hcx headers the app sets (sender, recipient, workflow id).
- ``recipient_code(claim)``: processing_id, else payer_id, else the default.
- ``default_payer_code()``: ``settings.NHCX_DEFAULT_PAYER_CODE`` ("" if unset).

FHIR inputs from models (nhcx-plan/mapping.json)
- ``facility_profile(facility) -> FacilityProfile | None``
- ``facility_input(facility) -> FacilityInput`` (D1: HFR id, name, code)
- ``payer_input(claim) -> PayerInput``
- ``patient_input(claim) -> PatientInput`` (emr.Patient, claim fallbacks)
- ``coverage_input(claim) -> CoverageInput``
- ``practitioner_input(user) -> PractitionerInput`` (PractitionerProfile)
- ``practitioner_inputs(claim) -> list[PractitionerInput]`` (D26 care team)
- ``line_inputs(claim) -> list[LineInput]`` (D16)

Lookups
- ``get_claim(claim_or_id) -> Claim``: by instance, external id or pk; raises
  ``ServiceRefusal("Claim not found.")``.

Payers
- ``payer_name(code) -> str | None``: the registry name (G4), cached; None
  when the lookup failed (retried after a few minutes).
- ``adapter(claim)``: ``services.payers.adapter_for(claim.payer_id)`` when
  that module exists, else a generic stand-in with ``key``/``desk``/
  ``auth_check_unasked``.
"""

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.cache import cache

from care.nhcx import archive
from care.nhcx.fhir.inputs import (
    CoverageInput,
    FacilityInput,
    LineInput,
    PatientInput,
    PayerInput,
    PractitionerInput,
)
from care.nhcx.gateway import get_gateway
from care.nhcx.gateway.errors import GatewayError, SendError
from care.nhcx.gateway.send import ensure_not_in_transaction

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

PAYER_NAME_TTL = 24 * 3600
PAYER_NAME_RETRY = 5 * 60
_MISSING = "__nhcx_missing__"
CLAIM_NOT_FOUND = "Claim not found."


class ServiceRefusal(Exception):  # noqa: N818 - contract name
    """A refusal before (or instead of) a send; the message is shown verbatim."""

    def __init__(self, message: str):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.message


@dataclass
class Ack:
    txn_id: str | None = None
    correlation_id: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    api_call_id: str | None = None
    ledger_id: str | None = None
    headers: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    response: Any = None
    failed: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "txn_id": self.txn_id,
            "correlation_id": self.correlation_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "api_call_id": self.api_call_id,
            "ledger_id": self.ledger_id,
            "failed": self.failed,
            "response": self.response,
        }


def _s(value) -> str:
    return "" if value is None else str(value).strip()


# ---- payer / participant codes ----


def default_payer_code() -> str:
    return _s(getattr(settings, "NHCX_DEFAULT_PAYER_CODE", ""))


def recipient_code(claim) -> str:
    return _s(claim.processing_id) or _s(claim.payer_id) or default_payer_code()


def facility_profile(facility):
    if facility is None:
        return None
    from care.nhcx.models import FacilityProfile

    return FacilityProfile.objects.filter(facility=facility).first()


def headers(claim, workflow_id, *, sender=None, status=None, extra=None) -> dict:
    if sender is None:
        profile = facility_profile(claim.facility)
        sender = _s(profile.participant_code) if profile else ""
    out = {
        "x-hcx-sender_code": sender,
        "x-hcx-recipient_code": recipient_code(claim),
        "x-hcx-workflow_id": _s(workflow_id),
    }
    if status:
        out["x-hcx-status"] = status
    if extra:
        out.update({k: v for k, v in extra.items() if v not in (None, "")})
    return out


def payer_name(code) -> str | None:
    code = _s(code)
    if not code:
        return None
    key = f"nhcx:payer-name:{code.lower()}"
    cached = cache.get(key)
    if cached is not None:
        return None if cached == _MISSING else cached
    try:
        gw = get_gateway()
        name = _s(gw.identity_for(code).fetch_participant(code).get("name")) or None
    except Exception as e:
        logger.info("nhcx: payer name lookup failed code=%s: %s", code, e)
        cache.set(key, _MISSING, PAYER_NAME_RETRY)
        return None
    cache.set(key, name or _MISSING, PAYER_NAME_TTL if name else PAYER_NAME_RETRY)
    return name


def adapter(claim):
    try:
        from care.nhcx.services import payers
    except ImportError:
        payers = None
    if payers is not None and hasattr(payers, "adapter_for"):
        return payers.adapter_for(getattr(claim, "payer_id", None) or "")
    return SimpleNamespace(key="generic", desk=None, auth_check_unasked=False)


def get_claim(claim_or_id):
    """A Claim, or one looked up by external id or pk; refuses "Claim not found."."""
    from care.nhcx.models import Claim

    if isinstance(claim_or_id, Claim):
        return claim_or_id
    claim = None
    value = _s(claim_or_id)
    if value:
        try:
            if value.isdigit():
                claim = Claim.objects.filter(pk=int(value)).first()
            else:
                claim = Claim.objects.filter(external_id=value).first()
        except Exception:
            claim = None
    if claim is None:
        raise ServiceRefusal(CLAIM_NOT_FOUND)
    return claim


# ---- FHIR inputs ----


def facility_input(facility) -> FacilityInput:
    profile = facility_profile(facility)
    return FacilityInput(
        identifier_value=_s(profile.hfr_id) if profile else "",
        name=_s(getattr(facility, "name", "")),
        participant_code=_s(profile.participant_code) if profile else "",
    )


def payer_input(claim) -> PayerInput:
    code = _s(claim.payer_id) or default_payer_code()
    return PayerInput(payer_id=code, payer_name=_s(claim.payer_name) or code)


def coverage_input(claim) -> CoverageInput:
    return CoverageInput(
        policy_code=_s(claim.policy_code), member_id=_s(claim.member_id)
    )


def patient_input(claim) -> PatientInput:
    patient = claim.patient
    abha = _s(claim.abha_number)
    name = gender = mobile = ""
    dob = None
    if patient is not None:
        from care.nhcx.models.abha import get_abha_number

        name = _s(patient.name)
        gender = _s(patient.gender)
        mobile = _s(patient.phone_number)
        dob = patient.date_of_birth
        abha = abha or _s(get_abha_number(patient))
    return PatientInput(
        member_id=_s(claim.member_id),
        abha_number=abha,
        beneficiary_name=_s(claim.beneficiary_name),
        patient_name=name or _s(claim.beneficiary_name),
        mobile_number=_s(claim.mobile_number) or mobile,
        patient_gender=gender or _s(claim.patient_gender),
        patient_dob=dob or claim.patient_dob,
    )


def practitioner_input(user) -> PractitionerInput:
    try:
        profile = user.nhcx_practitioner_profile
    except Exception:
        profile = None
    name = ""
    if hasattr(user, "get_full_name"):
        name = _s(user.get_full_name())
    name = name or _s(getattr(user, "username", ""))
    if profile is not None and profile.prefix and name:

def _log_ids(claim, path, ack: Ack, note: str) -> None:
    logger.info(
        "nhcx: send %s claim=%s correlation=%s ledger=%s %s",
        path,
        getattr(claim, "claim_no", None),
        ack.correlation_id,
        ack.ledger_id or ack.txn_id,
        note,
    )


def send(path: str, envelope: dict, claim, *, label: str = "") -> Ack:
    """APIs conventions SEND: the ids it went out under, and failed or None."""
    ensure_not_in_transaction()
    try:
        gw = get_gateway()
    except GatewayError as e:
        archive.archive_outbound(claim, path, envelope, None, label=label)
        raise ServiceRefusal(getattr(e, "reason", None) or e.message) from e
    try:
        result = gw.send(path, envelope)
    except SendError as e:
        if e.names_ids:
            ack = Ack(
                txn_id=e.txn_id,
                correlation_id=e.correlation_id,
                request_id=e.request_id,
                api_call_id=e.api_call_id,
                ledger_id=e.ledger_id,
                headers=dict(e.headers or {}),
                failed=e.message,
            )
            archive.archive_outbound(claim, path, envelope, ack, label=label)
            _log_ids(claim, path, ack, f"failed: {e.code}: {e.message}")
            return ack
        archive.archive_outbound(claim, path, envelope, None, label=label)
        logger.warning(
            "nhcx: send %s claim=%s refused before ids: %s: %s",
            path,
            getattr(claim, "claim_no", None),
            e.code,
            e.message,
        )
        raise ServiceRefusal(e.message) from e
    except GatewayError as e:
        archive.archive_outbound(claim, path, envelope, None, label=label)
        raise ServiceRefusal(e.message) from e
    ack = Ack(
        txn_id=result.txn_id,
        correlation_id=result.correlation_id,
        request_id=result.request_id,
        api_call_id=result.api_call_id,
        ledger_id=result.ledger_id,
        headers=dict(result.headers or {}),
        response=result.response,
    )
    if not result.ok:
        ack.failed = f"{result.error_code}: {result.error_message}"
    archive.archive_outbound(claim, path, envelope, ack, label=label)
    _log_ids(claim, path, ack, f"failed: {ack.failed}" if ack.failed else "accepted")
    return ack

Reads take a shared lock and writes an exclusive one; two concurrent misses for the same code both go to the registry, and the last one written wins. Nothing is persisted. With `certs.refuseSelfKey` true (the production default) that is `SELF_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and nothing is cached. In sandbox (default false) it is logged as a warning and used, because sandbox participants are often onboarded under one credential and really do share a certificate [SANDBOX](../references/PAYERS.md#markers). A code the gateway holds itself (a participant sending to itself, or one hosted participant writing to another) is never refused.

"""C1 callback door: receive, route, and the shared rules used by C2 to C10.

``receive(envelope, delivery)`` is what G8 calls (``settings.NHCX_RECEIVE_HANDLER``)
and returns ``{"outcome": settled|unmatched|ignored|rejected|error, "detail"}``.
Polling (A10 to A13) applies a reply found in the ledger through
``route(type, envelope, corr)`` with the leg's correlation id.

Handler modules (``care.nhcx.callbacks.<name>``) expose
``handle(envelope, delivery) -> outcome or result dict``; they are imported
lazily by name, and a missing module answers ``unmatched``. ``delivery`` carries
``correlation_id`` (the leg's) and, for ``task``/``status``, ``route`` = "C7"/"C8".

Shared rules (C1P): ``Rejected``, ``payload``, ``is_protocol_response``,
``rejection``, ``failed_send``, ``revive``, ``leg_write``, ``already_applied``,
``claim_for_correlation``, ``claim_named_in``, ``result`` and the outcome
constants ``SETTLED``, ``UNMATCHED``, ``IGNORED``, ``REJECTED``, ``ERROR``.
"""

import importlib
import logging

from django.db import transaction

from care.nhcx import archive
from care.nhcx.fhir import bundle as fb

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SETTLED = "settled"
UNMATCHED = "unmatched"
IGNORED = "ignored"
REJECTED = "rejected"
ERROR = "error"

TYPES = {
    "coverage",
    "insurance",
    "preauth",
    "task",
    "claim",
    "payment",
    "communication",
    "status",
}
CANCEL_REFUSED = "The payer did not accept the cancellation."
NO_PAYLOAD = "The callback carried no readable payload."


class Rejected(Exception):  # noqa: N818 - C1P's name
    def __init__(self, detail: str):
        super().__init__(detail)
        self.detail = detail


def result(outcome, detail="") -> dict:
    return {"outcome": outcome, "detail": detail or ""}


def _as_result(value) -> dict:
    if isinstance(value, dict) and "outcome" in value:
        return {"outcome": value["outcome"], "detail": value.get("detail") or ""}
    return result(str(value or SETTLED))


# ---- shared rules ----


def payload(envelope):
    body = envelope.get("fhir") if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        raise Rejected(NO_PAYLOAD)
    return body


def is_protocol_response(body) -> bool:
    try:
        return fb.is_protocol_response(body)
    except Exception:
        return False


def rejection(body) -> str:
    details = body.get("x-hcx-error_details") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if isinstance(details, str):
        text = fb.protocol_error(body)
        if text and ":" in text:
            return text
        return f"NHCX: {text or 'The gateway rejected the request.'}"
    details = details if isinstance(details, dict) else {}
    code = details.get("code") or "NHCX"
    message = details.get("message") or "The gateway rejected the request."
    return f"{code}: {message}"


def failed_send(row) -> bool:
    status = getattr(row, "status", None)
    if status == "error":
        return True
    msg = getattr(row, "error_message", None)
    return (
        bool(msg)
        and msg != CANCEL_REFUSED
        and status
        in {
            "approved",
            "partial",
            "queried",
        }
    )


def _claim_of(row):
    from care.nhcx.models import Claim

    if isinstance(row, Claim):
        return row
    return getattr(row, "claim", None)


def _restamp(row) -> None:
    from care.nhcx.services import stage

    claim = _claim_of(row)
    if claim is not None:
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        stage.recompute(claim)


def revive(row, waiting_status) -> bool:
    """Reopen a leg on record as a failed send (the payer answered it)."""
    if not failed_send(row):
        return False
    row.status = waiting_status
    row.error_message = None
    row.save()
    _restamp(row)
    logger.info(
        "nhcx: revived %s claim=%s corr=%s",
        type(row).__name__,

def delivery(type_, **kw):
    d = {

        "flow": "callback",
        "payload_kind": "jwe",
        "redelivery": False,
        "participant": "1000001234@hcx",
    }
    d.update(kw)
    return d

    def checking_claim(self):
        claim = self.make_claim()
        eligibility.run_check(claim, "validation", "POL-1", "PMJAY123")
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        return claim

    def test_c2_applies_verdict(self):
        claim = self.checking_claim()
        env = self.envelope(
            bundle("eligibility-response-generic.json"), claim.correlation_id
        )
        out = dispatch.receive(env, delivery("coverage"))
        self.assertEqual(out["outcome"], dispatch.SETTLED)
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.status, "eligible")
        self.assertTrue(claim.inforce)
        self.assertEqual(claim.abha_number, "91-1234-1234-1234")
        self.assertEqual(claim.plan_period_end, "2026-12-31")
        self.assertEqual((claim.stage, claim.sub_stage), ("eligibility", "eligible"))
        self.assertIsNotNone(claim.response_json)

    def test_redelivery_is_idempotent(self):
        claim = self.checking_claim()
        env = self.envelope(
            bundle("eligibility-response-generic.json"), claim.correlation_id
        )
        dispatch.receive(env, delivery("coverage"))
        claim.refresh_from_db()

class AuthRulingTests(NhcxCoreTestBase):
    def test_c3_applies_ruling(self):
        claim = self.make_claim(status="eligible")
        claim.lines.create(kind="Procedure", code="MG0111A")
        eligibility.request_auth(claim)
        ruling = ClaimAuth.objects.get(claim=claim)
        env = self.envelope(
            bundle("eligibility-auth-response-pmjay.json"), ruling.correlation_id
        )
        out = dispatch.receive(env, delivery("coverage"))
        self.assertEqual(out["outcome"], dispatch.SETTLED)
        ruling.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(ruling.status, "ready")
        self.assertEqual(ruling.items.count(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(ruling.requirements.count(), 12)
        self.assertIsNotNone(ruling.settled_at)
        again = dispatch.receive(env, delivery("coverage", redelivery=True))
        self.assertEqual(again["outcome"], dispatch.IGNORED)
        self.assertEqual(ruling.items.count(), 2)


class PlanCallbackTests(NhcxCoreTestBase):
    def fetching(self):
        claim = self.make_claim()
        plan.request_plan(claim)
        return claim, ClaimPlan.objects.get(claim=claim)

    def test_c4_applies_plan(self):
        _claim, row = self.fetching()
        env = self.envelope(bundle("plan-response-pmjay.json"), row.correlation_id)
        out = dispatch.receive(env, delivery("insurance"))
        self.assertEqual(out["outcome"], dispatch.SETTLED)
        row.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(row.status, "ready")
        self.assertEqual(row.plan_title, "PMJAY - Universal Health Policy")
        self.assertEqual(
            list(row.benefits.order_by("seq").values_list("seq", flat=True)),
            [1, 2, 3, 4],
        )
        first = row.benefits.get(seq=1)
        self.assertEqual(first.code, "MG004A")
        self.assertEqual(first.extras[0]["type"], "Stratification")
        self.assertEqual(row.forms.count(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(
            dispatch.receive(env, delivery("insurance"))["outcome"], dispatch.IGNORED
        )

# S14. Patient Registration Form Screen

> **Existing HMIS screen.** Most HMIS already have this screen. Do not rebuild it: add only what NHCX needs (the fields and actions marked for NHCX below, such as ABHA number and address, HPR id, registration and qualification) to the target's own screen, and record anything else as `found` in discovery.

#### S14R. ROUTE
patients/new (create mode)

patients/edit/:id (edit mode)

Breadcrumb in create mode: Patients (patients/list, S13) > Register

Breadcrumb in edit mode: Patients (S13) > <patient name> (patients/view/:id, S15) > Edit

Page title: "Register patient" in create mode, "Edit <patient name>" in edit mode.

#### S14D. DESCRIPTION
One form registers a new patient or edits an existing one. Both modes show the same fields. In edit mode every field is prefilled from the saved patient.

Fields are grouped into five collapsible sections. All sections can be open at once, and the first one (Identity) starts open.

Identity (two columns):

| Label | Control | Name | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full name | Text | `name` | Required (marked, and required in the browser) |
| Gender | Dropdown, blank option "Select" | `gender` | Required. Options: Male (`male`), Female (`female`), Other (`other`), Unknown (`unknown`). Saved as `unknown` if nothing arrives |
| Date of birth | Date picker | `birth_date` | Optional. Help text: "Leave blank and fill age if the DOB is unknown." |
| Age (years) | Number, min 0, max 130 | `age_years` | Optional. Used only when there is no date of birth |
| Given name | Text | `given_name` | Optional |
| Family name | Text | `family_name` | Optional |

Contact & ABHA (two columns):

| Label | Control | Name | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile number | Text | `phone` | Required (marked, and required in the browser) |
| Email | Email input | `email` | Optional |
| ABHA number | Text | `abha_number` | Optional. Help text: "Exported as Patient.identifier with type ABHA." |
| ABHA address | Text | `abha_address` | Optional |
| Verify or create an ABHA | Button (secondary) | | Opens the ABHA dialog ([A19. ABHA Create and Verify (ABDM M1)](../apis/A19-abha-m1.md)): verify an existing ABHA by its number or the mobile it is registered against (OTP, with an account chooser when one mobile holds several), or create one from an Aadhaar OTP with the person's consent recorded and an address chosen. On success the ABHA number and address are filled in, and name, gender, date of birth and mobile where the form still has them blank; a typed value is kept. The dialog's description reads: "Verify the person's ABHA with an OTP, or create one from their Aadhaar. What the ABHA service confirms is written onto the file." Opened from S13 "Register with ABHA", the whole form is filled from the profile and its description reads "Filled from ABHA <number>. Confirm the details; a UHID is issued on save." |

Demographics (two columns):

| Label | Control | Name | Options |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marital status | Dropdown, blank option "Not recorded" | `marital_status_code` | Married (`M`), Never Married (`S`), Widowed (`W`), Divorced (`D`), unmarried (`U`). |
| Blood group | Dropdown, blank option "Not recorded" | `blood_group` | A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O- |

Address:

| Label | Control | Name |
|---|---|---|
| Address line | Text, full width | `address_line` |
| City / town | Text | `city` |
| District | Text | `district` |
| State | Text | `state` |
| PIN code | Text | `postal_code` |

Country is not shown. It is always saved as "India".

Emergency contact (three columns):

| Label | Control | Name |
|---|---|---|
| Contact name | Text | `contact_name` |
| Relationship | Text (free text) | `contact_relation` |
| Contact phone | Text | `contact_phone` |

Rules:
- Create: if Full name or Mobile number is empty, the form reloads with the red message "Name and mobile number are mandatory." and nothing is saved.
- Create: on success the system allocates the next MRN, then opens S15 with the green message "Patient registered with MRN <mrn>."
- Edit: the values are saved and S15 opens with "Patient record updated." The MRN never changes.
- Edit of a patient id that does not exist shows "Patient could not be found." with a "Back to dashboard" button.
- There is no format check on mobile number, ABHA number or PIN code.

NHCX use:
- ABHA number is the key that joins a claim to a hospital patient. A confirmed policy is matched to a current inpatient stay whose patient has the same ABHA number, digits only, so "91-7034-1237-4240" and "91703412374240" match (S4). Without it the claim cannot be linked.

API: [A4. Pre-auth Submit](../apis/A4-preauth-submit.md), [A5. Claim Submit](../apis/A5-claim-submit.md)

Data: [D3. patient](../database/D3-patient.md)

#### S14L. LAYOUT
The arrangement below is the reference implementation's [REF](../references/PAYERS.md#markers): follow the target HMIS's own screen conventions. What is required is in DESCRIPTION and ACTIONS: the fields, options, columns, statuses, messages and actions.


```
|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Patients > Register                                              |
|------------------------------------------------------------------|
| [Card]                                                           |
|  v Identity                                                      |
|    Full name *            Gender *                               |
|    [______________]       [Select          v]                    |
|    Date of birth          Age (years)                            |
|    [dd-mm-yyyy]           [___]                                  |
|    Leave blank and fill age if the DOB is unknown.               |
|    Given name             Family name                            |
|    [______________]       [______________]                       |
|  > Contact & ABHA                                                |
|  > Demographics                                                  |
|  > Address                                                       |
|  > Emergency contact                                             |
|------------------------------------------------------------------|
|  [Cancel]                                  [Register patient]    |
|------------------------------------------------------------------|
```

- One card with no title. The body is an accordion of the five sections in the order above.
- Required fields carry a required marker next to the label.
- The card footer holds "Cancel" (secondary, left) and the submit button (primary, medium, right). The submit label is "Register patient" in create mode and "Save changes" in edit mode.
- Section grids collapse to one column on narrow screens.

#### S14A. ACTIONS
1. Register patient (create mode): validate, create the patient, and go to the Patient Detail screen S15 with the success message.
2. Save changes (edit mode): save and go to S15 for that patient.
3. Cancel: go to the Patient List S13 without saving (in both modes).
4. Breadcrumb "Patients": go to S13. In edit mode, the patient name crumb goes to S15.
5. Expand or collapse a section: show or hide its fields. Values in a collapsed section are still submitted.
6. Verify or create an ABHA: run the ABHA dialog (A19) and fill the form from its profile; the form is not saved until Register patient or Save changes.
7. Under PMJAY, the beneficiary is verified biometrically before registration where the scheme asks for it; the verification lives on the case's Verification tab ([S18. Beneficiary Verification](S18-beneficiary-verification.md), [A18. Biometric Authentication](../apis/A18-biometric-authentication.md), stage Preauth) and is recorded against the patient and read by the sends.

def added_lines(claim, row=None):
    row = row if row is not None else existing(claim)
    sent = sent_codes(row.request_json if row is not None else None)
    return [line for line in claim.lines.order_by("seq", "id") if line.code not in sent]


def send_kind(claim) -> str:
    row = existing(claim)
    if row is None or row.status in {"cancelled", "error"}:
        return "preauth"
    if row.status in {"approved", "partial"}:
        if not added_lines(claim, row):
            raise common.ServiceRefusal(DECIDED)
        return "enhancement"
    if row.status == "queried":
        if (row.enhancement_no or 0) > 0 and row.submission_kind in ENHANCEMENT_KINDS:
            return "enhancement_resubmit"
        return "preauth_query_response"
    if row.status == "rejected":
        return "preauth"
    if row.status in {"submitting", "cancelling"}:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(WITH_PAYER)
    return "preauth"


# ---- gather + build ----


def claim_input(claim, kind, *, builder_kind, reply="", with_forms=True) -> tuple:
    org = _gather.facility(claim)
    diagnoses, practitioners, lines = _gather.check_draft(claim)
    adapter = payers.adapter_for_claim(claim)
    forms = _gather.form_inputs(claim, "preauth") if with_forms else []
    data = ClaimInput(
        kind=builder_kind,
        claim_no=claim.claim_no,
        patient=common.patient_input(claim),
        facility=org,
        payer=common.payer_input(claim),
        coverage=common.coverage_input(claim),
        practitioners=practitioners,
        diagnoses=diagnoses,
        lines=lines,
        documents=_gather.documents(claim, "preauth"),
        forms=forms,
        answers=_gather.answers(claim, "preauth", forms) if forms else [],
        admission_date=claim.admission_date,
        expected_discharge_date=claim.expected_discharge_date,
        preauth_ref="",
        reply_text=reply,
        procedure_types=_gather.procedure_types(claim),
        program_code=adapter.program_code,
        procedure_factor=adapter.procedure_factor,
        created=timezone.now(),
    )
    return data, org, adapter, _gather.total(lines)


def submit_preauth(claim, reply="") -> ClaimPreauth:  # noqa: PLR0912
    claim = common.get_claim(claim)
    if claim.status != "eligible":
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NOT_ELIGIBLE)
    row = existing(claim)
    kind = send_kind(claim)
    answer = None
    if kind in QUERY_KINDS:
        answer = _s(reply)
        if not answer:
            raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_REPLY)

    from care.nhcx.services import eligibility

    eligibility.ensure_auth_requirements(claim)

    data, org, adapter, total = claim_input(
        claim, kind, builder_kind=BUILDER_KIND[kind], reply=answer or ""
    )
    if row is not None and kind != "preauth":
        data.preauth_ref = _s(row.preauth_ref)
    bundle = build_bundle(claim_builder, data)
    workflow = workflow_for(adapter, kind)
    extra = {"x-hcx-use_case": payers.use_case_for(kind)}
    extra.update(_gather.biometric_headers(claim, "preauth"))
    envelope = {
        "jwe_headers": common.headers(
            claim,
            workflow,
            sender=org.participant_code,
            status=payers.status_for(kind),
            extra=extra,
        ),
        "fhir": bundle,
    }
    ack = common.send(PATH, envelope, claim, label=kind)
    now = timezone.now()
    values = {
        "status": "submitting",
        "txn_id": ack.txn_id,
        "correlation_id": ack.correlation_id,
        "submitted_at": now,
        "settled_at": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "claim_ref": claim.claim_no,
        "preauth_ref": None,
        "outcome": None,
        "adjudication": None,
        "disposition": None,
        "approved_amount": None,
        "eligible_amount": None,
        "submitted_amount": None,
        "items_json": None,
        "requested_amount": total,
        "submission_kind": kind,
        "reply_text": answer,
        "workflow_id": workflow,
        "request_json": bundle,
        "response_json": None,
        "api_call_id": None,
    }
    if row is not None and kind in ENHANCEMENT_KINDS:
        values["preauth_ref"] = row.preauth_ref
        values["enhancement_no"] = (row.enhancement_no or 0) + (
            1 if kind == "enhancement" else 0
        )
    elif row is not None and kind in {"preauth_resubmit", "preauth_query_response"}:
        values["preauth_ref"] = row.preauth_ref
        values["enhancement_no"] = row.enhancement_no
    if kind in ENHANCEMENT_KINDS:
        for key in (
            "settled_at",
            "outcome",
            "adjudication",
            "disposition",
            "approved_amount",
            "eligible_amount",
            "submitted_amount",
            "items_json",
        ):
            values.pop(key, None)
    if ack.failed:
        if kind in ENHANCEMENT_KINDS and row is not None:
            values = {
                "status": row.status,
                "txn_id": ack.txn_id,
                "correlation_id": ack.correlation_id,
                "submitted_at": now,
                "error_message": ack.failed,
                "submission_kind": kind,
                "workflow_id": workflow,
                "enhancement_no": values.get("enhancement_no"),
            }
        else:
            values["status"] = "error"
            values["error_message"] = ack.failed
    if row is None:
        row = ClaimPreauth(claim=claim)
    for key, value in values.items():
        setattr(row, key, value)
    row.save()
    stage.recompute(claim)
    logger.info(
        "nhcx: preauth %s claim=%s corr=%s failed=%s",
        kind,
        claim.claim_no,
        ack.correlation_id,
        bool(ack.failed),
    )
    if ack.failed:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(ack.failed)
    return row


def ask_predetermination(claim) -> ClaimPredetermination:
    claim = common.get_claim(claim)
    if claim.status != "eligible":
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(QUOTE_NOT_ELIGIBLE)
    if ClaimPredetermination.objects.filter(claim=claim, status="asking").exists():
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(QUOTE_WAITING)
    data, org, _adapter, total = claim_input(
        claim, "predetermination", builder_kind="predetermination", with_forms=False
    )
    bundle = build_bundle(claim_builder, data)
    envelope = {
        "jwe_headers": common.headers(
            claim,
            PREDETERMINATION_WORKFLOW,
            sender=org.participant_code,
            extra={"x-hcx-use_case": payers.use_case_for("predetermination")},
        ),
        "fhir": bundle,
    }
    ack = common.send(PATH, envelope, claim, label="predetermination")
    row = ClaimPredetermination.objects.create(
        claim=claim,
        status="error" if ack.failed else "asking",
        txn_id=ack.txn_id,
        correlation_id=ack.correlation_id,
        requested_at=timezone.now(),
        requested_amount=total,
        request_json=bundle,
        error_message=ack.failed,
    )
    stage.recompute(claim)
    if ack.failed:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(ack.failed)
    return row

def task_parties(claim):
    claim = common.get_claim(claim)
    org = _gather.facility(claim, TASK_SETTINGS)
    return claim, org, common.payer_input(claim)

    }

    stage.recompute(claim)

        "nhcx: claim %s claim=%s corr=%s failed=%s",
        kind,
        claim.claim_no,
        ack.correlation_id,
        bool(ack.failed),
    )
    if ack.failed:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(ack.failed)
    return state

"""L7.1: the NHCX tests run isolated from the real gateway, its keys and the
network."""

import os
import socket

from django.conf import settings
from django.test import SimpleTestCase

from care.nhcx import tasks
from care.nhcx.gateway import GatewayNotConfigured, get_gateway, reset_gateway
from care.nhcx.tests import network_guard


class SettingsPinnedTests(SimpleTestCase):
    def test_gateway_settings_off(self):
        self.assertEqual(settings.NHCX_GATEWAY_CONFIG, "")
        self.assertFalse(settings.NHCX_ROLE)
        self.assertFalse(settings.NHCX_SHARED_TOKEN_CACHE)
        self.assertEqual(settings.NHCX_ARCHIVE_DIR, "")
        self.assertFalse(settings.NHCX_ADJUDICATOR_CONSOLE)
        self.assertEqual(settings.NHCX_HOSTED_PARTICIPANTS, "")

    def test_env_overrides_scrubbed(self):
        for name in (
            "NHCX_ENV",
            "NHCX_URL",
            "NHCX_PARTICIPANT_URL",
            "NHCX_SESSIONS_URL",
            "NHCX_PUBLIC_URL",
            "NHCX_CM_ID",
        ):
            self.assertNotIn(name, os.environ)

    def test_real_gateway_never_opens(self):
        reset_gateway()
        self.addCleanup(reset_gateway)
        with self.assertRaises(GatewayNotConfigured):
            get_gateway()

    def test_scheduled_work_is_off(self):
        self.assertFalse(tasks.should_run() if hasattr(tasks, "should_run") else 0)


class NetworkGuardTests(SimpleTestCase):
    def test_installed(self):
        self.assertTrue(network_guard.installed())

    def test_external_lookup_blocked(self):
        with self.assertRaises(network_guard.NetworkBlockedError):
            socket.getaddrinfo("apisbx.abdm.gov.in", 443)

    def test_external_connect_blocked(self):
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.addCleanup(sock.close)
        with self.assertRaises(network_guard.NetworkBlockedError):
            sock.connect(("203.0.113.10", 443))
        with self.assertRaises(network_guard.NetworkBlockedError):
            sock.connect_ex(("8.8.8.8", 53))

    def test_requests_cannot_swallow_the_block(self):
        import requests

        with self.assertRaises(network_guard.NetworkBlockedError):
            requests.get("https://apis.abdm.gov.in/", timeout=1)

    def test_loopback_allowed(self):
        self.assertTrue(socket.getaddrinfo("127.0.0.1", 9))
        self.assertTrue(socket.getaddrinfo("localhost", 9))
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.addCleanup(sock.close)
        sock.settimeout(0.5)
        self.assertIsInstance(sock.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", 9)), int)

    def test_allow_rules(self):
        self.assertTrue(network_guard.allowed("127.0.0.1"))
        self.assertTrue(network_guard.allowed("::1"))
        self.assertTrue(network_guard.allowed(None))
        self.assertFalse(network_guard.allowed("nhcx.test"))
        self.assertFalse(network_guard.allowed("10.1.2.3"))

    def test_scoped_to_nhcx_tests(self):
        # A call whose stack holds no care/nhcx/tests frame is let through.
        code = compile(
            "allowed = guard._from_nhcx_test()",  # noqa: SLF001
            "/elsewhere/other_test.py",
            "exec",
        )
        scope = {"guard": network_guard}
        exec(code, scope)  # noqa: S102
        self.assertTrue(scope["allowed"])

def delivery(type_, corr="", **kw):
    d = {
        "path": f"/v1/{type_}/on_x",
        "type": type_,
        "flow": "callback",
        "payload_kind": "jwe",
        "redelivery": False,
        "participant": "1000001234@hcx",
        "correlation_id": corr,
    }
    d.update(kw)
    return d


class LegCallbackBase(NhcxCoreTestBase):
    def eligible_claim(self, **kw):
        return self.make_claim(status="eligible", **kw)

    def receive(self, name_or_body, corr, type_, api_call_id="reply-api-1", **headers):
        body = bundle(name_or_body) if isinstance(name_or_body, str) else name_or_body
        env = self.envelope(body, corr, api_call_id, **headers)
        return dispatch.receive(env, delivery(type_, corr))

def send_task(claim, org, workflow, data: TaskInput, *, label):
    data.facility = org
    data.authored_on = data.authored_on or timezone.now()
    bundle = build_bundle(task_builder, data)
    envelope = {
        "jwe_headers": common.headers(claim, workflow, sender=org.participant_code),
        "fhir": bundle,
    }
    return bundle, common.send(TASK_PATH, envelope, claim, label=label)


def send_enquiry(claim, kind, leg, org, workflow, data, reason="", **extra):
    bundle, ack = send_task(claim, org, workflow, data, label=kind)
    row = ClaimEnquiry.objects.create(
        claim=claim,
        kind=kind,
        stage=leg,
        txn_id=ack.txn_id,
        correlation_id=ack.correlation_id,
        requested_at=timezone.now(),
        status="error" if ack.failed else "asking",
        reason=reason or None,
        request_json=bundle,
        error_message=ack.failed,
        **extra,
    )
    if ack.failed:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(ack.failed)
    return row


def _status_label(status) -> str:
    return STATUS_LABELS.get(status, _s(status).lower() or "unsent")


def cancel_preauth(claim, reason, note="") -> ClaimPreauth:
    from care.nhcx.models.legs import CancelReason

    claim = common.get_claim(claim)
    sent = existing(claim)
    if sent is None:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NOTHING_TO_CANCEL)
    if sent.status not in CANCELLABLE:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(
            NOT_CANCELLABLE.format(status=_status_label(sent.status))
        )
    reason = _s(reason)
    if reason not in CancelReason.values:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_CANCEL_REASON)
    note = _s(note)
    if reason == "other" and not note:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_OTHER_NOTE)
    claim, org, payer = task_parties(claim)
    adapter = payers.adapter_for_claim(claim)
    data = TaskInput(
        action="cancel",
        leg="preauth",
        claim_no=claim.claim_no,
        payer=payer,
        reason=reason,
        note=note,
        intimation_number=claim.claim_no,
        intimation_type=payers.intimation_input(adapter, "cancel"),
    )
    _bundle, ack = send_task(
        claim, org, workflow_for(adapter, "cancel"), data, label="cancel"
    )
    sent.pre_cancel_status = sent.status
    sent.status = "error" if ack.failed else "cancelling"
    sent.cancel_txn_id = ack.txn_id
    sent.cancel_correlation_id = ack.correlation_id
    sent.cancel_requested_at = timezone.now()
    sent.cancel_reason = reason
    sent.cancel_note = note or None
    sent.error_message = ack.failed
    sent.save()
    stage.recompute(claim)
    if ack.failed:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(ack.failed)
    return sent


def ask_status(claim, leg) -> ClaimEnquiry:
    claim = common.get_claim(claim)
    if leg not in {"preauth", "claim"}:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(BAD_STAGE)
    adapter = payers.adapter_for_claim(claim)
    if not adapter.status_enquiry:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_STATUS.format(name=adapter.name))
    claim_ref, thread = leg_reference(claim, leg)
    claim, org, payer = task_parties(claim)
    data = TaskInput(action="status", leg=leg, claim_no=claim_ref, payer=payer)
    return send_enquiry(claim, "status", leg, org, thread or STATUS_WORKFLOW, data)

def record_discharge(claim, data) -> ClaimSubmission:  # noqa: PLR0912
    """S11 discharge card: validates, saves; opens the claim in draft."""
    from care.nhcx.models.legs import DischargeMode, DischargeStage

    claim = common.get_claim(claim)
    state = submission(claim)
    if state is not None and state.status == "submitting":
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(DISCHARGE_LOCKED)
    mode = _s(data.get("discharge_mode"))
    if mode not in DischargeMode.values:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_MODE)
    when = _s(data.get("discharge_stage"))
    if when not in DischargeStage.values:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_STAGE)
    discharge, _ = _moment(data.get("discharge_date"))
    if discharge is None:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_DISCHARGE_DATE)
    admission = _day(claim.admission_date)
    if admission and _day(discharge) < admission:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(DISCHARGE_BEFORE_ADMISSION)
    surgery, _ = _moment(data.get("surgery_date"))
    if surgery is not None:
        if admission and _day(surgery) < admission:
            raise common.ServiceRefusal(SURGERY_BEFORE_ADMISSION)
        if _day(discharge) < _day(surgery):
            raise common.ServiceRefusal(DISCHARGE_BEFORE_SURGERY)
    death = None
    if mode == "death":
        raw = data.get("death_date")
        death, timed = _moment(raw)
        if death is None:
            raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_DEATH)
        if not timed:
            raise common.ServiceRefusal(NO_DEATH_TIME)
    if state is None:
        state = ClaimSubmission(claim=claim, status="draft")
    elif state.status == "error":
        state.status = "draft"
    state.discharge_mode = mode
    state.discharge_stage = when
    state.discharge_date = discharge
    state.surgery_date = surgery
    state.death_date = death
    state.save()
    stage.recompute(claim)
    return state

    money = rows.filter(id=payment_id).first() if payment_id else None
    if money is None:
        raise common.ServiceRefusal(NOT_FOUND)
    case = money.claim
    try:
        facility = common.facility_input(case.facility)
        if not facility.identifier_value or not facility.participant_code:
            raise common.ServiceRefusal(SETTINGS)
        claim_no = _s(money.claim_ref) or case.claim_no
        bundle = payment_ack.build(claim_no, facility, common.payer_input(case))
        adapter = payers.adapter_for_claim(case)
        try:
            workflow = payers.workflow_id(adapter, "payment_ack")
        except ValueError:
            workflow = ""
        workflow = (
            workflow or _s(money.workflow_id) or _s(money.claim_ref) or case.claim_no
        )
        envelope = {

content.text:
I validated all 113 backend files in code.json. 109 pass, 4 were fixed and none failed. The full NHCX suite passes (261 tests, more than the 250 at the start because the other agent is adding tests), ruff is clean on the files I changed, and nothing is committed.

**Fixes:**
- **`fhir/read/claim_response.py`**: a reply with outcome `error` but reason queried, submitted or acknowledged was saved as `error`; it now becomes queried or submitting, as C5P says. Under an approving workflow id, `partial` now needs reason approved, not just outcome partial. Error lines now read `<code>: <display or text>` (they had no colon), and a disposition of "ok" is no longer added to the message.
- **`fhir/read/eligibility.py`**: the verdict is read from the first CoverageEligibilityResponse instead of the last. `auth_required` and `excluded` stay empty when the payer leaves them out, instead of becoming false.
- **`fhir/read/plan.py`**: a plan that comes back with no packages no longer gets the "carries no InsurancePlan" message; that message is now only for replies with no InsurancePlan at all.
- **`tests/test_fhir_read.py`**: two assertions expected the old partial and error-line behaviour; I changed them to match the spec.

**What else was checked:**
- **Gateway:** send, receive, crypto and headers match their G specs.
- **Callbacks:** C1–C10 match their specs.
- **Services:** A2, A4, A5, A6 and A8 refuse before sending, send outside a transaction and keep the ids of a failed send. Every refusal message in the A and C specs appears verbatim in the code.
- **FHIR builders:** I built sample bundles and compared them element by element with the F8 and F2 tables. nhcx-docs has no Claim example, so the tables were the only reference.
- **Models:** every D9–D31 column, null rule and default matches.

The remaining files had a lighter check: imports, refusal wording and the green test suite.

**Open findings (warnings, not changed):**
- **Gateway spec conflict:** G8D says no ledger row is written for an unmatched delivery, but G8S says every delivered outcome is recorded. The code follows G8S.
- **C5 denied enhancement:** the code fills `error_message` from the query note or disposition, where the spec says the payer's reason or disposition. It is the same payer text in practice.

I updated the moved line numbers in `_agent/fhir.json`.

Files are in `<root>/care/nhcx-plan/`:
- validation.json
- _agent/validate-backend-log.json

"""L7.7 dry run: one claim walked S1 to S12 through the real API endpoints, with
a real Gateway (G1) opened on a throwaway config and test keys, against a fake
NHCX and registry. Every outbound request is encrypted by G6 for the payer's
test certificate and decrypted here with the payer's test key; every payer
reply is encrypted for the facility's test key and delivered through the G8
inbound route, so the C1 dispatcher sees what NHCX would hand it.

No call leaves the process (the network guard in tests/__init__.py refuses it).
"""

import json

from django.test import override_settings

from care.nhcx.callbacks import dispatch
from care.nhcx.gateway import crypto, reset_gateway, set_gateway
from care.nhcx.gateway import headers as H  # noqa: N812
from care.nhcx.models import (
    Claim,
    ClaimAuth,
    ClaimPayment,
    ClaimPlan,
    ClaimPreauth,
    ClaimQuery,
    ClaimSubmission,
)
from care.nhcx.models.abha import set_abha
from care.nhcx.tests.core_helpers import NhcxCoreTestBase, bundle
from care.nhcx.tests.gateway_helpers import (
    FACILITY,
    PARTICIPANT_URL,
    PAYER,
    FakeResponse,
    ScratchDirMixin,
    key,
)

ABHA = "91-1234-1234-1234"
POLICY = {
    "memberid": "MEM-7781",
    "name": "Ravi Kumar",
    "payerid": PAYER,
    "policyno": "POL-7781",
    "productname": "Family Floater Gold",
    "abhanumber": ABHA,
}
PAYER_RECORD = {
    "participants": [
        {
            "participant_code": PAYER,
            "participant_name": "Acme Health Insurance",
            "status": "Active",
            "roles": ["payor"],
        }
    ]
}
# claim numbers baked into the fixture bundles, rewritten to the case's own
FIXTURE_CLAIM_NOS = (
    "NM-26-0SE00002I",
    "NM-26-0SE00002M",
    "NM-26-0SE00002L",
)


@override_settings(NHCX_DEFAULT_PAYER_CODE=PAYER)
class DryFlowBase(ScratchDirMixin, NhcxCoreTestBase):
    payer_name = "Acme Health Insurance"

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        record = json.loads(json.dumps(PAYER_RECORD))
        record["participants"][0]["participant_name"] = self.payer_name
        self.gw = self.open_gateway(receive=dispatch.receive)
        self.addCleanup(self.gw.stop)
        self.http.on(
            PARTICIPANT_URL + "/participant/get/policies", FakeResponse(200, [POLICY])
        )
        self.http.on(PARTICIPANT_URL + "/participant/search", FakeResponse(200, record))
        set_gateway(self.gw)
        self.addCleanup(reset_gateway)
        self.profile.participant_code = FACILITY
        self.profile.save()
        self.payer_key = crypto.parse_private_key(key("payer-private.pem"))
        self.facility_public = crypto.parse_public_key(key("facility-public.pem"))
        self.client.force_authenticate(self.user)

    # ---- API ----

    def url(self, suffix=""):
        return f"/api/v1/facility/{self.facility.external_id}/nhcx/{suffix}"

    def post(self, suffix, data=None, expect=200):
        resp = self.client.post(self.url(suffix), data or {}, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, expect, getattr(resp, "data", resp))
        return resp

    def put(self, suffix, data):
        resp = self.client.put(self.url(suffix), data, format="json")
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200, getattr(resp, "data", resp))
        return resp

    def state(self, claim_id):
        resp = self.client.get(self.url(f"claims/{claim_id}/state/"))
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200, getattr(resp, "data", resp))
        return resp.data

    # ---- fake NHCX ----

    def sent(self, path_suffix):
        """The last request G6 posted to NHCX on ``path_suffix``, as the payer
        would decrypt it: (protected headers, FHIR bundle)."""
        calls = self.http.calls_to(path_suffix)
        self.assertTrue(calls, f"nothing was sent to {path_suffix}")
        data = calls[-1]["data"]
        payload = json.loads(data)["payload"]
        hdr = crypto.parse_header(payload)
        fhir = json.loads(crypto.decrypt(payload, self.payer_key))
        self.assertEqual(hdr[H.SENDER_CODE], FACILITY)
        self.assertEqual(hdr[H.RECIPIENT_CODE], PAYER)
        return hdr, fhir

    def reply(self, path, fhir, corr, *, workflow="", status="response.complete"):
        """The payer's answer, encrypted for the facility and posted to the G8
        inbound route as NHCX would. Returns the JSON acknowledgement."""
        hdr = {
            H.SENDER_CODE: PAYER,
            H.RECIPIENT_CODE: FACILITY,
            H.API_CALL_ID: H.new_id(),
            H.CORRELATION_ID: corr,
            H.REQUEST_ID: H.new_id(),
            H.TIMESTAMP: H.timestamp(),
            H.STATUS: status,
        }
        if workflow:
            hdr[H.WORKFLOW_ID] = workflow
        jwe = crypto.encrypt(json.dumps(fhir), self.facility_public, hdr)
        self.last_inbound = json.dumps({"payload": jwe}).encode()
        return self.deliver(path, self.last_inbound)

    def deliver(self, path, body):
        resp = self.client.generic(
            "POST", f"/{path}", body, content_type="application/json"
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 202, resp.content)
        out = json.loads(resp.content)
        self.assertIsNone(out.get("error"), out)
        return out

    def ours(self, name, claim):
        text = json.dumps(bundle(name))
        for other in FIXTURE_CLAIM_NOS:
            text = text.replace(other, claim.claim_no)
        return json.loads(text)


class DryFlowTests(DryFlowBase):
    def test_claim_s1_to_s12(self):  # noqa: PLR0915
        # S1/S2, A1 via G10: policy search on the registry
        found = self.post("policy-search/", {"member_id": "MEM-7781"})
        self.assertEqual(found.data["policies"][0]["member_id"], "MEM-7781")
        asked = self.http.calls_to("/participant/get/policies")
        self.assertEqual(
            json.loads(asked[-1]["data"])
            if isinstance(asked[-1]["data"], str | bytes)
            else asked[-1]["data"],
            {"identifiertype": "MemberId", "identifiervalue": "MEM-7781"},
        )

        # S2: open the case (D9)
        opened = self.post(
            "claims/",
            {
                "policy": found.data["policies"][0]["raw"],
                "identifiertype": "MemberId",
                "identifiervalue": "MEM-7781",
            },
        )
        claim_id = opened.data["claim_id"]
        claim = Claim.objects.get(external_id=claim_id)
        self.assertEqual((claim.payer_id, claim.member_id), (PAYER, "MEM-7781"))
        self.assertEqual(claim.stage, "eligibility")

        # S3, A2 -> C2: eligibility
        checked = self.post(
            f"claims/{claim_id}/eligibility/", {"purpose": "validation"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            checked.data["message"], "Eligibility request queued to the payer."
        )
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.status, "checking")
        hdr, fhir = self.sent("coverageeligibility/check")
        self.assertEqual(fhir["resourceType"], "Bundle")
        self.assertEqual(hdr[H.CORRELATION_ID], claim.correlation_id)
        ack = self.reply(
            "v1/coverageeligibility/on_check",
            bundle("eligibility-response-generic.json"),
            claim.correlation_id,
        )
        self.assertEqual(ack["correlation_id"], claim.correlation_id)
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.status, "eligible")
        self.assertEqual(claim.abha_number, ABHA)
        self.assertEqual((claim.stage, claim.sub_stage), ("eligibility", "eligible"))
        # NHCX redelivers the same reply: acknowledged, applied once
        self.deliver("v1/coverageeligibility/on_check", self.last_inbound)
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.status, "eligible")

        # S7, A3 -> C4: the payer's insurance plan (D10-D12)
        self.post(f"claims/{claim_id}/plan/")
        plan = ClaimPlan.objects.get(claim=claim)
        self.assertEqual(plan.status, "fetching")
        hdr, _ = self.sent("insuranceplan/request")
        self.reply(
            "v1/insuranceplan/on_request",
            bundle("plan-response-generic.json"),
            plan.correlation_id,
        )
        plan.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(plan.status, "ready", plan.error_message)
        self.assertTrue(plan.benefits.exists())
        code = plan.benefits.order_by("seq").first().code

        # S8: a line item from the plan (D16), then the auth requirements (C3)
        added = self.post(
            f"claims/{claim_id}/lines/", {"kind": "Procedure", "code": code}
        )
        self.assertEqual(added.data["line"]["code"], code)
        self.post(f"claims/{claim_id}/auth-requirements/")
        ruling = ClaimAuth.objects.get(claim=claim)
        self.assertEqual(ruling.status, "checking")
        _, fhir = self.sent("coverageeligibility/check")
        self.reply(
            "v1/coverageeligibility/on_check",
            bundle("eligibility-auth-response-pmjay.json"),
            ruling.correlation_id,
        )
        ruling.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(ruling.status, "ready", ruling.error_message)

        # S4: link the admission and fill the draft (D25, D26)
        patient = self.create_patient(name="Ravi Kumar")
        set_abha(patient, number=ABHA)
        org = self.create_facility_organization(facility=self.facility)
        enc = self.create_encounter(patient, self.facility, org)
        enc.encounter_class = "imp"
        enc.status = "in_progress"
        enc.period = {"start": "2026-01-02T10:00:00+05:30"}
        enc.save()
        self.post(f"claims/{claim_id}/admission/", {"encounter": str(enc.external_id)})
        self.put(
            f"claims/{claim_id}/draft/",
            {
                "diagnoses": [{"icd10_code": "K35.8", "icd10_display": "Appendicitis"}],
                "care_team": [{"role": "treating", "practitioner": self.user.id}],
            },
        )
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.encounter_id, enc.id)
        self.assertEqual(claim.diagnoses.count(), 1)

        # S9, A4 -> C9/A7 -> C5: pre-authorisation, a payer query, the answer
        sent = self.post(f"claims/{claim_id}/preauth/submit/")
        self.assertEqual(
            sent.data["message"], "Pre-authorisation submitted to the payer."
        )
        preauth = ClaimPreauth.objects.get(claim=claim)
        self.assertEqual(preauth.status, "submitting")
        hdr, fhir = self.sent("preauth/submit")
        self.assertEqual(hdr[H.CORRELATION_ID], preauth.correlation_id)
        self.assertEqual(fhir["resourceType"], "Bundle")
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.stage, "preauth")

        with self.captureOnCommitCallbacks(execute=True):
            self.reply(
                "v1/communication/request",
                self.ours("communication-query-wf24.json", claim),
                preauth.correlation_id,
                status="request.initiated",
            )
        query = ClaimQuery.objects.get(claim=claim)
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.sub_stage, "queried")
        answered = self.post(
            f"claims/{claim_id}/queries/{query.external_id}/reply/",
            {"text": "Discharge summary attached as asked.", "document_ids": []},
        )
        self.assertEqual(answered.data["message"], "Reply sent to the payer.")
        hdr, fhir = self.sent("communication/on_request")
        self.assertEqual(fhir["resourceType"], "Bundle")
        query.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNotNone(query.replied_at)

        self.reply(
            "v1/preauth/on_submit",
            self.ours("preauth-approved-wf21.json", claim),
            preauth.correlation_id,
        )
        preauth.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(preauth.status, "approved", preauth.error_message)
        self.assertTrue(preauth.approved_amount)
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual((claim.stage, claim.sub_stage), ("preauth", "approved"))

        # S11, A5 -> C6: discharge, then the claim
        self.post(
            f"claims/{claim_id}/discharge/",
            {
                "discharge_mode": "normal",
                "discharge_stage": "After Surgery",
                "discharge_date": "2026-01-06",
            },
        )
        self.post(f"claims/{claim_id}/claim/submit/")
        submission = ClaimSubmission.objects.get(claim=claim)
        self.assertEqual(submission.status, "submitting")
        hdr, fhir = self.sent("claim/submit")
        self.assertEqual(hdr[H.CORRELATION_ID], submission.correlation_id)
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.stage, "claim")
        self.reply(
            "v1/claim/on_submit",
            self.ours("claim-approved-deduction-wf26-pmjay.json", claim),
            submission.correlation_id,
        )
        submission.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIn(submission.status, {"approved", "partial"})

        # S12, C10 -> A8: the payment notice, acknowledged
        with self.captureOnCommitCallbacks(execute=True):
            self.reply(
                "v1/paymentnotice/request",
                self.ours("payment-notice-wf30.json", claim),
                submission.correlation_id,
                status="request.initiated",
            )
        money = ClaimPayment.objects.get(claim=claim)
        self.assertTrue(self.http.calls_to("paymentnotice/on_request"))
        money.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(money.ack_status, "sent")
        claim.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(claim.stage, "payment")
        acked = self.post(f"claims/{claim_id}/payments/{money.external_id}/ack/")
        self.assertEqual(acked.data["message"], "Payment acknowledged to the payer.")
        self.sent("paymentnotice/on_request")

        # A17: the state the screens read reflects the whole walk
        final = self.state(claim_id)
        self.assertEqual(final["claim"]["status"], "eligible")
        self.assertEqual(final["plan"]["status"], "ready")
        self.assertEqual([x["code"] for x in final["lines"]], [code])
        # A13: every leg was recorded in the ledger
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(self.gw.ledger.list(limit=100)), 14)
