"""What every scenario shares: open a claim, check it, plan it, quote, send."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import timedelta

from django.core.files.uploadedfile import SimpleUploadedFile
from django.utils import timezone

from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.cli.runner import Blocked, Refused

PDF = (
    b"%PDF-1.4\n1 0 obj<</Type/Catalog/Pages 2 0 R>>endobj\n"
    b"2 0 obj<</Type/Pages/Kids[3 0 R]/Count 1>>endobj\n"
    b"3 0 obj<</Type/Page/Parent 2 0 R/MediaBox[0 0 200 200]>>endobj\n"
    b"trailer<</Root 1 0 R>>\n%%EOF\n"
)
DIAGNOSIS = ("S68.4", "Traumatic amputation of hand at wrist level")
SETTLED_PREAUTH = {"approved", "partial", "queried", "rejected", "cancelled", "error"}
SETTLED_CLAIM = {"approved", "partial", "queried", "rejected", "error"}
OPEN_PREAUTH = {"submitting", "approved", "partial", "queried"}
UNKNOWN_MEMBER = "E2E-NOBODY-0000"


@dataclass
class Scenario:
    id: str
    payer: str
    title: str
    run: object = None
    gui: bool = True
    notes: str = ""
    extra: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def payer_code(ctx, payer):
    return ctx.conf.get(f"NHCX_TEST_{payer.upper()}_PAYER")


def member_id(ctx, payer):
    value = ctx.conf.get(f"NHCX_TEST_{payer.upper()}_MEMBER_ID")
    if not value:
        raise Blocked(
            f"NHCX_TEST_{payer.upper()}_MEMBER_ID is not set; ask the integrator",
            "setup",
        )
    return value


def search(ctx, member, *, what="policy search finds the member"):
    try:
        body = ctx.api(
            "POST",
            "policy-search/",
            {"identifiertype": "MemberId", "identifiervalue": member},
        )
    except Refused as e:
        ctx.fail(what, f"refused {e.status}: {e.error}", "sandbox")
    return body.get("policies") or []


def patient_for(ctx, policy):
    from care.nhcx.models.abha import find_patients_by_abha

    abha = policy.get("abha_number") or ""
    return find_patients_by_abha(abha).order_by("id").first() if abha else None


def open_claim(ctx, payer, *, label="") -> tuple[str, dict]:
    """Searches the member, picks the payer's policy and opens a claim on it."""
    member = member_id(ctx, payer)
    code = payer_code(ctx, payer)
    rows = search(ctx, member)
    policy = next((r for r in rows if r.get("payer_id") == code), None)
    ctx.check(
        policy is not None,
        f"policy search finds {payer.upper()} member{label}",
        f"{len(rows)} policies, payers {sorted({r.get('payer_id') for r in rows})}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    patient = patient_for(ctx, policy)
    body = {
        "policy": policy,
        "identifiertype": "MemberId",
        "identifiervalue": member,
    }
    if patient is not None:
        body["patient"] = str(patient.external_id)
    opened = ctx.send("provider opens the claim", "POST", "claims/", body)
    claim_id = opened["claim_id"]
    ctx.claims.append(claim_id)
    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    ctx.step(
        f"claim opened{label}",
        f"{c.claim_no}, payer {c.payer_id}, processing {c.processing_id or '-'}",
    )
    return claim_id, policy


def eligibility(ctx, claim_id, purpose, *, expect="eligible"):
    before = ctx.claim(claim_id).correlation_id
    ctx.send(
        f"provider sends the {purpose} check",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/eligibility/",
        {"purpose": purpose},
    )
    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    corr = c.correlation_id
    ctx.corr(corr)
    ctx.check(
        bool(corr) and corr != before and c.status != "error",
        f"{purpose} check goes out",
        f"{c.status}, correlation {corr}" + (f", {c.error_message}" if c.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    (status, how) = ctx.wait_for(
        f"payer answers the {purpose} check",
        claim_id,
        lambda k: k.status if k.status != "checking" else None,
        corr,
    )
    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    ctx.check(
        status == expect and c.correlation_id == corr,
        f"payer answers the {purpose} check",
        f"{status} by {how}, inforce {c.inforce}, period {c.plan_period_start}"
        f"..{c.plan_period_end}, allowed {c.allowed_amount}"
        + (f", {c.error_message}" if c.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return c


def admit(ctx, claim_id):
    from care.emr.models import Encounter

    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    if c.encounter_id:
        return
    enc = (
        Encounter.objects.filter(
            patient=c.patient, facility=ctx.facility, status="in_progress"
        )
        .order_by("-id")
        .first()
    )
    if enc is None:
        raise Blocked("the test beneficiary has no open admission; run setup", "setup")
    ctx.send(
        "provider links the admission",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/admission/",
        {"encounter": str(enc.external_id)},
    )


def request_plan(ctx, claim_id):
    ctx.send("provider requests the plan", "POST", f"claims/{claim_id}/plan/", {})
    row = ctx.claim(claim_id).plan
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status != "error",
        "plan request goes out",
        f"{row.status}, correlation {row.correlation_id}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return row


def wait_plan(ctx, claim_id):
    row = request_plan(ctx, claim_id)
    corr = row.correlation_id
    status, how = ctx.wait_for(
        "payer sends the plan",
        claim_id,
        lambda k: k.plan.status if k.plan.status != "fetching" else None,
        corr,
        seconds=ctx.conf.int("NHCX_TEST_PLAN_WAIT_SECONDS"),
    )
    row = ctx.claim(claim_id).plan
    codes = list(row.benefits.order_by("seq").values_list("code", "rate")[:5])
    ctx.check(
        status == "ready" and bool(codes),
        "payer sends the plan",
        f"{status} by {how}, {row.plan_title or row.plan_identifier}, "
        f"{row.benefits.count()} packages e.g. {codes[:3]}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return row


def add_line(ctx, claim_id, code, quantity=1):
    body = ctx.send(
        f"provider quotes {code} x{quantity}",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/lines/",
        {"kind": "Procedure", "code": code, "quantity": quantity},
    )
    line = (body or {}).get("line") or {}
    ctx.step(
        f"provider quotes {code} x{quantity}",
        f"{line.get('display') or code}, {line.get('amount')}",
    )
    return line


def first_package(ctx, claim_id):
    row = ctx.claim(claim_id).plan
    b = row.benefits.exclude(rate__isnull=True).order_by("seq").first()
    return b.code if b else None


def rule(ctx, claim_id):
    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    elig_corr = c.correlation_id
    ctx.send(
        "provider asks for the auth requirements",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/auth-requirements/",
        {},
    )
    auth = ctx.claim(claim_id).auth
    ctx.corr(auth.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        auth.status != "error",
        "auth-requirements check goes out",
        f"{auth.status}, correlation {auth.correlation_id}"
        + (f", {auth.error_message}" if getattr(auth, "error_message", None) else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    status, how = ctx.wait_for(
        "payer rules on the auth requirements",
        claim_id,
        lambda k: k.auth.status if k.auth.status != "checking" else None,
        auth.correlation_id,
    )
    auth = ctx.claim(claim_id).auth
    reqs = list(auth.requirements.values_list("kind", "code", "at_preauth"))
    ctx.check(
        status == "ready" and auth.correlation_id != elig_corr,
        "payer rules on the auth requirements",
        f"{status} by {how} on {auth.correlation_id} (not {elig_corr}); "
        f"{len(reqs)} requirements: "
        + ", ".join(f"{k}:{code}" for k, code, _ in reqs[:8]),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return auth


def upload(ctx, claim_id, *, code="", stage="preauth", label="e2e document"):
    body = ctx.send(
        f"provider attaches {code or label}",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/documents/",
        {
            "file": SimpleUploadedFile(
                f"{code or 'doc'}.pdf", PDF, content_type="application/pdf"
            ),
            "code": code,
            "category": "DIA",
            "stage": stage,
            "label": label,
        },
        multipart=True,
    )
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimDocument

    return ClaimDocument.objects.get(external_id=body["document_id"])


def _answer(ctx, claim_id, item, stage):
    kind = (item.get("type") or "").lower()
    if kind == "attachment":
        doc = upload(
            ctx, claim_id, code="ODN", stage=stage, label=item.get("text") or "form"
        )
        return str(doc.id)
    options = item.get("options") or []
    if options:
        first = options[0]
        return first.get("display") or first.get("code") if isinstance(first, dict) else str(first)
    if kind in {"datetime", "date"}:
        return timezone.now().date().isoformat()
    if kind in {"integer", "decimal"}:
        return "1"
    if kind == "boolean":
        return "true"
    return "e2e"


def answer_forms(ctx, claim_id, stage):
    st = ctx.state(claim_id)
    forms = (st.get("required_forms") or {}).get(stage) or []
    answers = []
    for form in forms:
        for item in form.get("questions") or []:
            if not item.get("required") and (item.get("type") or "").lower() == "attachment":
                continue
            answers.append(
                {
                    "form_url": form["url"],
                    "link_id": item.get("linkId"),
                    "answer": _answer(ctx, claim_id, item, stage),
                    "stage": stage,
                }
            )
    if answers:
        ctx.send(
            f"provider answers the {stage} forms",
            "PUT",
            f"claims/{claim_id}/draft/",
            {"answers": answers, "stage": stage},
        )
    return [f.get("title") or f.get("url") for f in forms]


def attach_required(ctx, claim_id, stage):
    st = ctx.state(claim_id)
    docs = (st.get("required_documents") or {}).get(stage) or []
    for d in docs:
        if not d.get("attached_document_id"):
            upload(ctx, claim_id, code=d.get("code"), stage=stage, label=d.get("display"))
    return [d.get("code") for d in docs]


def fill_draft(ctx, claim_id):
    admit(ctx, claim_id)
    today = timezone.now().date()
    code, display = DIAGNOSIS
    if ctx.conf.get("NHCX_TEST_DIAGNOSIS"):
        code, _, display = ctx.conf.get("NHCX_TEST_DIAGNOSIS").partition(" ")
        display = display.strip() or code
    ctx.send(
        "provider saves the pre-authorisation draft",
        "PUT",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/draft/",
        {
            "admission_date": (today - timedelta(days=1)).isoformat(),
            "expected_discharge_date": (today + timedelta(days=3)).isoformat(),
            "diagnoses": [{"icd10_code": code, "icd10_display": display}],
            "care_team": [
                {"role": "treating", "practitioner": str(ctx.doctor.external_id)}
            ],
        },
    )
    docs = attach_required(ctx, claim_id, "preauth")
    forms = answer_forms(ctx, claim_id, "preauth")
    ctx.step(
        "pre-authorisation draft ready",
        f"diagnosis {code}, doctor {ctx.doctor.username}, "
        f"documents {docs or '-'}, forms {forms or '-'}",
    )


def preauth_row(ctx, claim_id):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimPreauth

    return ClaimPreauth.objects.filter(claim__external_id=claim_id).first()


def submit_preauth(ctx, claim_id, *, what="provider sends the pre-authorisation", body=None):
    before = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
    before_corr = before.correlation_id if before else None
    ctx.send(what, "POST", f"claims/{claim_id}/preauth/submit/", body or {})
    row = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status != "error" and row.correlation_id and row.correlation_id != before_corr,
        what,
        f"{row.submission_kind}, {row.status}, workflow {row.workflow_id}, "
        f"correlation {row.correlation_id}, amount {row.requested_amount}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox" if row.error_message and "PAYR" in (row.error_message or "") else "ours",
    )
    return row


def wait_preauth(ctx, claim_id, corr, *, what="provider receives the decision", settled=None):
    settled = settled or SETTLED_PREAUTH

    def ready(k):
        row = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
        if row is None or row.correlation_id != corr:
            return None
        return row.status if row.status in settled else None

    status, how = ctx.wait_for(what, claim_id, ready, corr)
    row = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
    return row, how


def decide(ctx, claim_id, stage, decision, remarks=""):
    from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.payer import driver

    record = driver.decide(ctx.claim(claim_id), stage, decision, remarks)
    ctx.decisions.append(record)
    read = record.get("read") or {}
    if record.get("skipped"):
        ctx.skip("payer desk reads the case", record["skipped"])
        ctx.skip(f"payer desk takes {decision}", record["skipped"])
        return record
    ctx.check(
        bool(read.get("role")),
        "payer desk reads the case",
        f"{read.get('caseNumber')}, {read.get('role')}, "
        f"{_case_view(read.get('response'))}"
        + (f", {read.get('error')}" if read.get("error") else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    ok = record.get("stopped") in {"decided", "completed"}
    trail = ", ".join(
        f"{s.get('action')} as {s.get('role')}"
        + ("" if s.get("success") else f" (refused: {s.get('error')})")
        for s in record.get("trail") or []
    )
    ctx.check(
        ok,
        f"payer desk takes {decision}",
        f"{record.get('stopped')}, {trail or record.get('error')}, cycle {record.get('cycle_id')}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    return record


def _case_view(response):
    if not isinstance(response, dict):
        return str(response)[:80]
    keep = ("id", "stage", "adjudication", "status", "claimed_amount")
    return ", ".join(f"{k} {response[k]}" for k in keep if response.get(k) is not None)


def prepare_irdai(ctx, *, rule_it=True, label=""):
    """A claim with the IRDAI policy, eligible, a plan line and its ruling."""
    claim_id, _policy = open_claim(ctx, "irdai", label=label)
    eligibility(ctx, claim_id, "validation")
    admit(ctx, claim_id)
    wait_plan(ctx, claim_id)
    code = first_package(ctx, claim_id)
    add_line(ctx, claim_id, code)
    if rule_it:
        rule(ctx, claim_id)
    fill_draft(ctx, claim_id)
    return claim_id


def approved_preauth(ctx, *, label=""):
    claim_id = prepare_irdai(ctx, label=label)
    row = submit_preauth(ctx, claim_id)
    decide(ctx, claim_id, "preauth", "approve", "e2e approval")
    row, how = wait_preauth(ctx, claim_id, row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status == "approved",
        "provider receives the approval",
        f"{row.status} by {how}, {row.approved_amount}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    return claim_id


def discharge(ctx, claim_id, stage="claim"):
    today = timezone.now().date().isoformat()
    ctx.send(
        "provider records the discharge",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/discharge/",
        {
            "discharge_mode": "normal",
            "discharge_stage": "After Surgery",
            "discharge_date": today,
            "surgery_date": today,
        },
    )


def submission_row(ctx, claim_id):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimSubmission

    return ClaimSubmission.objects.filter(claim__external_id=claim_id).first()


def submit_claim(ctx, claim_id, *, what="provider sends the claim", body=None):
    before = submission_row(ctx, claim_id)
    before_corr = before.correlation_id if before else None
    ctx.send(what, "POST", f"claims/{claim_id}/claim/submit/", body or {})
    row = submission_row(ctx, claim_id)
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status != "error" and bool(row.correlation_id) and row.correlation_id != before_corr,
        what,
        f"{row.submission_kind}, {row.status}, workflow {row.workflow_id}, "
        f"correlation {row.correlation_id}, preauth {row.preauth_ref or '-'}, "
        f"amount {row.requested_amount}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox" if "PAYR" in (row.error_message or "") else "ours",
    )
    return row


def wait_claim(ctx, claim_id, corr, *, what="provider receives the claim decision", settled=None):
    settled = settled or SETTLED_CLAIM

    def ready(k):
        row = submission_row(ctx, claim_id)
        if row is None or row.correlation_id != corr:
            return None
        return row.status if row.status in settled else None

    ctx.wait_for(what, claim_id, ready, corr)
    return submission_row(ctx, claim_id)

"""The scenarios, one per test (T3 to T19), in tests/INDEX.md order.

Both runners share these definitions: the CLI runner runs ``run(ctx)``; the GUI
runner reads the same list (``nhcx_e2e list --json``) and drives the screens
for the same test, taking the payer's side through the same payer driver.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib

from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios.common import Scenario

TESTS = (
    ("T3", "irdai", "IRDAI Policy Search and Eligibility", "t03_irdai_policy_and_eligibility"),
    ("T4", "irdai", "IRDAI Insurance Plan and Authorisation Requirements", "t04_irdai_plan_and_auth_requirements"),
    ("T5", "irdai", "IRDAI Pre-authorisation Approved", "t05_irdai_preauth_approved"),
    ("T6", "irdai", "IRDAI Pre-authorisation Rejected and Sent Again", "t06_irdai_preauth_rejected"),
    ("T7", "irdai", "IRDAI Query Answered", "t07_irdai_query_answered"),
    ("T8", "irdai", "IRDAI Enhancement", "t08_irdai_enhancement"),
    ("T9", "irdai", "IRDAI Status Enquiry and Cancel", "t09_irdai_cancel_and_status"),
    ("T10", "irdai", "IRDAI Claim Approved, Part-approved and Rejected", "t10_irdai_claim"),
    ("T11", "irdai", "IRDAI Payment Notice and Acknowledgement", "t11_irdai_payment"),
    ("T12", "irdai", "IRDAI Reprocess and Balance Release", "t12_irdai_reprocess_and_release"),
    ("T13", "pmjay", "PMJAY Eligibility, Package Master and Ruling", "t13_pmjay_eligibility_and_package_master"),
    ("T14", "pmjay", "PMJAY Pre-authorisation Through the Payer Service", "t14_pmjay_preauth_adjudicated"),
    ("T15", "pmjay", "PMJAY Query Answered by Resubmission", "t15_pmjay_query_by_resubmission"),
    ("T16", "pmjay", "PMJAY Rejection and Enhancement", "t16_pmjay_rejection_and_enhancement"),
    ("T17", "pmjay", "PMJAY Claim Through the Role Walk", "t17_pmjay_claim_adjudicated"),
    ("T18", "pmjay", "PMJAY Payment Notice, Status Refusal and Cancel", "t18_pmjay_payment_status_cancel"),
    ("T19", "pmjay", "PMJAY Beneficiary Verification and ABHA", "t19_pmjay_biometric_and_abha"),
)


def _load(module):
    try:
        return importlib.import_module(f"{__name__}.{module}")
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        return None


def all_scenarios() -> list:
    out = []
    for tid, payer, title, module in TESTS:
        mod = _load(module)
        out.append(
            Scenario(
                id=tid,
                payer=payer,
                title=title,
                run=getattr(mod, "run", None),
                gui=getattr(mod, "GUI", True),
                notes=(mod.__doc__ or "").strip() if mod else "not written",
            )
        )
    return out


def select(names) -> list:
    """``[]`` is everything; ``irdai``/``pmjay`` select a payer; else ids."""
    found = all_scenarios()
    if not names:
        return found
    wanted = {n.upper() for n in names}
    return [
        s
        for s in found
        if s.id in wanted or s.payer.upper() in wanted
    ]

"""``manage.py nhcx_e2e``: the NHCX end-to-end runner (T2L).

    nhcx_e2e list [--json]
    nhcx_e2e check
    nhcx_e2e setup
    nhcx_e2e run [T3 T5 ... | irdai | pmjay] [--mode cli|gui|both] [--headed] [--report PATH]
    nhcx_e2e payer read|decide|lines|pay|case CLAIM ...   (the payer driver, JSON out)
    nhcx_e2e seed-plan CLAIM
    nhcx_e2e free-beneficiary
    nhcx_e2e report-merge FILE                           (GUI entries into the report)

Exit codes for ``run``: 0 every test passed, 1 any failed, 2 any blocked by
configuration or setup.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from care.nhcx.tests.e2e import checks
from care.nhcx.tests.e2e import config as cfg
from care.nhcx.tests.e2e import report

HOST_COMMAND = "care/scripts/nhcx-e2e.sh run {tests} --mode {mode}{headed}"
FE_DIR_HINT = "../care_fe"


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = __doc__.splitlines()[0]

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
        ls = sub.add_parser("list")
        ls.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
        sub.add_parser("check")
        sub.add_parser("setup")
        run = sub.add_parser("run")
        run.add_argument("tests", nargs="*")
        run.add_argument("--mode", choices=("cli", "gui", "both"))
        run.add_argument("--headed", action="store_true")
        run.add_argument("--report")
        run.add_argument("--keep-seed", action="store_true")
        payer = sub.add_parser("payer")
        payer.add_argument("act", choices=("read", "decide", "lines", "pay", "case"))
        payer.add_argument("claim")
        payer.add_argument("args", nargs="*")
        payer.add_argument("--stage", default="preauth")
        payer.add_argument("--remarks", default="")
        seed = sub.add_parser("seed-plan")
        seed.add_argument("claim")
        sub.add_parser("free-beneficiary")
        merge = sub.add_parser("report-merge")
        merge.add_argument("file")

    def handle(self, *args, **opts):
        action = opts["action"].replace("-", "_")
        return getattr(self, f"do_{action}")(opts)

    # ---- list / check / setup ----

    def do_list(self, opts):
        from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios import all_scenarios

        rows = [
            {"id": s.id, "payer": s.payer, "title": s.title, "written": s.run is not None}
            for s in all_scenarios()
        ]
        if opts["json"]:
            self.stdout.write(json.dumps(rows))
            return
        for r in rows:
            mark = "" if r["written"] else "  (not written)"
            self.stdout.write(f"{r['id']:4} {r['payer']:6} {r['title']}{mark}")

    def do_check(self, opts):
        conf = cfg.load()
        rows = checks.run(conf)
        for r in rows:
            self.stdout.write(f"{r['result'].upper():4} {r['check']:24} {r['detail']}")
        missing = conf.missing_integrator_values()
        if missing:
            self.stdout.write("missing integrator values: " + ", ".join(missing))
        report.merge(conf.report_path(), conf.report_view(), rows)

        from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios import select

        if opts.get("report"):
            overrides["NHCX_TEST_REPORT"] = opts["report"]
        conf = cfg.load(overrides)
        mode = opts.get("mode") or conf.get("NHCX_TEST_MODE") or "both"
        names = opts["tests"] or [
            n for n in (conf.get("NHCX_TEST_ONLY") or "").replace(",", " ").split() if n
        ]
        chosen = select(names)
        if not chosen:
            raise CommandError(f"no test matches {names}")
        path = conf.report_path()
        rows = checks.run(conf)
        for r in rows:
            self.stdout.write(f"setup {r['result'].upper():4} {r['check']:22} {r['detail']}")
        if checks.failed(rows):
            entries = [
                _blocked(s.id, runner, "setup", "setup checks failed")
                for s in chosen
                for runner in _runners(mode)
            ]
            report.merge(path, conf.report_view(), rows, entries)
            sys.exit(2)
        entries = []
        if mode in ("cli", "both"):
            for s in chosen:
                if s.run is None:
                    entry = _blocked(s.id, "cli", "ours", "scenario not written", "skipped")
                else:
                    entry = run_one(conf, s, out=self.stdout.write)
                entries.append(entry)
                report.merge(path, conf.report_view(), rows, [entry])
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{s.id} cli {entry['result'].upper()}"
                    + (f" ({entry['cause']}: {entry['detail'][:200]})" if entry["detail"] else "")
                )

            code = self._gui(conf, chosen, opts)

            entries += [gui[s.id] for s in chosen if s.id in gui]
            if code is None:
                sys.exit(2)
        data = report.merge(path, conf.report_view(), rows, [])
        self.stdout.write(f"report {path}: {json.dumps(data['summary'])}")
        results = {e["result"] for e in entries}
        if "fail" in results:

        cmd = ["npx", "playwright", "test", "--config", "tests/nhcx/playwright.config.ts"]

        env = {"NHCX_TEST_ONLY": tests}
        import os

        return subprocess.call(cmd, cwd=fe, env={**os.environ, **env})  # noqa: S603

    def do_payer(self, opts):
        from care.nhcx.services import common
        from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.payer import driver

        claim = common.get_claim(opts["claim"])
        act, rest, stage = opts["act"], opts["args"], opts["stage"]
        if act == "read":
            out = driver.read(claim, stage)
        elif act == "decide":
            out = driver.decide(claim, stage, rest[0], opts["remarks"])
        elif act == "lines":
            amounts = [None if a in ("-", "") else float(a) for a in rest]
            out = driver.irdai_lines(claim, stage, amounts)
        elif act == "pay":
            out = driver.irdai_pay(claim, float(rest[0]), rest[1], stage=stage)
        else:

"""What every scenario shares: open a claim, check it, plan it, quote, send."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import timedelta

@dataclass
class Scenario:
    id: str
    payer: str
    title: str
    run: object = None
    gui: bool = True
    notes: str = ""
    extra: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def payer_code(ctx, payer):
    return ctx.conf.get(f"NHCX_TEST_{payer.upper()}_PAYER")


def member_id(ctx, payer):
    value = ctx.conf.get(f"NHCX_TEST_{payer.upper()}_MEMBER_ID")
    if not value:
        raise Blocked(
            f"NHCX_TEST_{payer.upper()}_MEMBER_ID is not set; ask the integrator",
            "setup",
        )
    return value


def search(ctx, member, *, what="policy search finds the member"):
    try:
        body = ctx.api(
            "POST",
            "policy-search/",
            {"identifiertype": "MemberId", "identifiervalue": member},
        )
    except Refused as e:
        ctx.fail(what, f"refused {e.status}: {e.error}", "sandbox")
    return body.get("policies") or []


def patient_for(ctx, policy):
    from care.nhcx.models.abha import find_patients_by_abha

    abha = policy.get("abha_number") or ""
    return find_patients_by_abha(abha).order_by("id").first() if abha else None


def open_claim(ctx, payer, *, label="") -> tuple[str, dict]:
    """Searches the member, picks the payer's policy and opens a claim on it."""
    member = member_id(ctx, payer)
    code = payer_code(ctx, payer)
    rows = search(ctx, member)
    policy = next((r for r in rows if r.get("payer_id") == code), None)
    ctx.check(
        policy is not None,
        f"policy search finds {payer.upper()} member{label}",
        f"{len(rows)} policies, payers {sorted({r.get('payer_id') for r in rows})}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    patient = patient_for(ctx, policy)
    body = {
        "policy": policy,
        "identifiertype": "MemberId",
        "identifiervalue": member,
    }
    if patient is not None:
        body["patient"] = str(patient.external_id)
    opened = ctx.send("provider opens the claim", "POST", "claims/", body)
    claim_id = opened["claim_id"]
    ctx.claims.append(claim_id)
    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    ctx.step(
        f"claim opened{label}",
        f"{c.claim_no}, payer {c.payer_id}, processing {c.processing_id or '-'}",
    )
    return claim_id, policy


def eligibility(ctx, claim_id, purpose, *, expect="eligible"):
    before = ctx.claim(claim_id).correlation_id
    ctx.send(
        f"provider sends the {purpose} check",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/eligibility/",
        {"purpose": purpose},
    )
    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    corr = c.correlation_id
    ctx.corr(corr)
    ctx.check(
        bool(corr) and corr != before and c.status != "error",
        f"{purpose} check goes out",
        f"{c.status}, correlation {corr}" + (f", {c.error_message}" if c.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    (status, how) = ctx.wait_for(
        f"payer answers the {purpose} check",
        claim_id,
        lambda k: k.status if k.status != "checking" else None,
        corr,
    )
    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    ctx.check(
        status == expect and c.correlation_id == corr,
        f"payer answers the {purpose} check",
        f"{status} by {how}, inforce {c.inforce}, period {c.plan_period_start}"
        f"..{c.plan_period_end}, allowed {c.allowed_amount}"
        + (f", {c.error_message}" if c.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return c


def admit(ctx, claim_id):
    from care.emr.models import Encounter

    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    if c.encounter_id:
        return
    enc = (
        Encounter.objects.filter(
            patient=c.patient, facility=ctx.facility, status="in_progress"
        )
        .order_by("-id")
        .first()
    )
    if enc is None:
        raise Blocked("the test beneficiary has no open admission; run setup", "setup")
    ctx.send(
        "provider links the admission",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/admission/",
        {"encounter": str(enc.external_id)},
    )


def request_plan(ctx, claim_id):
    ctx.send("provider requests the plan", "POST", f"claims/{claim_id}/plan/", {})
    row = ctx.claim(claim_id).plan
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status != "error",
        "plan request goes out",
        f"{row.status}, correlation {row.correlation_id}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return row


def wait_plan(ctx, claim_id):
    row = request_plan(ctx, claim_id)
    corr = row.correlation_id
    status, how = ctx.wait_for(
        "payer sends the plan",
        claim_id,
        lambda k: k.plan.status if k.plan.status != "fetching" else None,
        corr,
        seconds=ctx.conf.int("NHCX_TEST_PLAN_WAIT_SECONDS"),
    )
    row = ctx.claim(claim_id).plan
    codes = list(row.benefits.order_by("seq").values_list("code", "rate")[:5])
    ctx.check(
        status == "ready" and bool(codes),
        "payer sends the plan",
        f"{status} by {how}, {row.plan_title or row.plan_identifier}, "
        f"{row.benefits.count()} packages e.g. {codes[:3]}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return row


def add_line(ctx, claim_id, code, quantity=1):
    body = ctx.send(
        f"provider quotes {code} x{quantity}",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/lines/",
        {"kind": "Procedure", "code": code, "quantity": quantity},
    )
    line = (body or {}).get("line") or {}
    ctx.step(
        f"provider quotes {code} x{quantity}",
        f"{line.get('display') or code}, {line.get('amount')}",
    )
    return line


def first_package(ctx, claim_id):
    row = ctx.claim(claim_id).plan
    b = row.benefits.exclude(rate__isnull=True).order_by("seq").first()
    return b.code if b else None


def rule(ctx, claim_id):
    c = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    elig_corr = c.correlation_id
    ctx.send(
        "provider asks for the auth requirements",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/auth-requirements/",
        {},
    )
    auth = ctx.claim(claim_id).auth
    ctx.corr(auth.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        auth.status != "error",
        "auth-requirements check goes out",
        f"{auth.status}, correlation {auth.correlation_id}"
        + (f", {auth.error_message}" if getattr(auth, "error_message", None) else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    status, how = ctx.wait_for(
        "payer rules on the auth requirements",
        claim_id,
        lambda k: k.auth.status if k.auth.status != "checking" else None,
        auth.correlation_id,
    )
    auth = ctx.claim(claim_id).auth
    reqs = list(auth.requirements.values_list("kind", "code", "at_preauth"))
    ctx.check(
        status == "ready" and auth.correlation_id != elig_corr,
        "payer rules on the auth requirements",
        f"{status} by {how} on {auth.correlation_id} (not {elig_corr}); "
        f"{len(reqs)} requirements: "
        + ", ".join(f"{k}:{code}" for k, code, _ in reqs[:8]),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return auth


def upload(ctx, claim_id, *, code="", stage="preauth", label="e2e document"):
    body = ctx.send(
        f"provider attaches {code or label}",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/documents/",
        {
            "file": SimpleUploadedFile(
                f"{code or 'doc'}.pdf", PDF, content_type="application/pdf"
            ),
            "code": code,
            "category": "DIA",
            "stage": stage,
            "label": label,
        },
        multipart=True,
    )
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimDocument

    return ClaimDocument.objects.get(external_id=body["document_id"])


def _answer(ctx, claim_id, item, stage):
    kind = (item.get("type") or "").lower()
    if kind == "attachment":
        doc = upload(
            ctx, claim_id, code="ODN", stage=stage, label=item.get("text") or "form"
        )
        return str(doc.id)
    options = item.get("options") or []
    if options:
        first = options[0]
        return first.get("display") or first.get("code") if isinstance(first, dict) else str(first)
    if kind in {"datetime", "date"}:
        return timezone.now().date().isoformat()
    if kind in {"integer", "decimal"}:
        return "1"
    if kind == "boolean":
        return "true"
    return "e2e"


def answer_forms(ctx, claim_id, stage):
    st = ctx.state(claim_id)
    forms = (st.get("required_forms") or {}).get(stage) or []
    answers = []
    for form in forms:
        for item in form.get("questions") or []:
            if not item.get("required") and (item.get("type") or "").lower() == "attachment":
                continue
            answers.append(
                {
                    "form_url": form["url"],
                    "link_id": item.get("linkId"),
                    "answer": _answer(ctx, claim_id, item, stage),
                    "stage": stage,
                }
            )
    if answers:
        ctx.send(
            f"provider answers the {stage} forms",
            "PUT",
            f"claims/{claim_id}/draft/",
            {"answers": answers, "stage": stage},
        )
    return [f.get("title") or f.get("url") for f in forms]


def attach_required(ctx, claim_id, stage):
    st = ctx.state(claim_id)
    docs = (st.get("required_documents") or {}).get(stage) or []
    for d in docs:
        if not d.get("attached_document_id"):
            upload(ctx, claim_id, code=d.get("code"), stage=stage, label=d.get("display"))
    return [d.get("code") for d in docs]


def fill_draft(ctx, claim_id):
    admit(ctx, claim_id)
    today = timezone.now().date()
    code, display = DIAGNOSIS
    if ctx.conf.get("NHCX_TEST_DIAGNOSIS"):
        code, _, display = ctx.conf.get("NHCX_TEST_DIAGNOSIS").partition(" ")
        display = display.strip() or code
    ctx.send(
        "provider saves the pre-authorisation draft",
        "PUT",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/draft/",
        {
            "admission_date": (today - timedelta(days=1)).isoformat(),
            "expected_discharge_date": (today + timedelta(days=3)).isoformat(),
            "diagnoses": [{"icd10_code": code, "icd10_display": display}],
            "care_team": [
                {"role": "treating", "practitioner": str(ctx.doctor.external_id)}
            ],
        },
    )
    docs = attach_required(ctx, claim_id, "preauth")
    forms = answer_forms(ctx, claim_id, "preauth")
    ctx.step(
        "pre-authorisation draft ready",
        f"diagnosis {code}, doctor {ctx.doctor.username}, "
        f"documents {docs or '-'}, forms {forms or '-'}",
    )


def preauth_row(ctx, claim_id):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimPreauth

    return ClaimPreauth.objects.filter(claim__external_id=claim_id).first()


def submit_preauth(ctx, claim_id, *, what="provider sends the pre-authorisation", body=None):
    before = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
    before_corr = before.correlation_id if before else None
    ctx.send(what, "POST", f"claims/{claim_id}/preauth/submit/", body or {})
    row = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status != "error" and row.correlation_id and row.correlation_id != before_corr,
        what,
        f"{row.submission_kind}, {row.status}, workflow {row.workflow_id}, "
        f"correlation {row.correlation_id}, amount {row.requested_amount}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox" if row.error_message and "PAYR" in (row.error_message or "") else "ours",
    )
    return row


def wait_preauth(ctx, claim_id, corr, *, what="provider receives the decision", settled=None):
    settled = settled or SETTLED_PREAUTH

    def ready(k):
        row = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
        if row is None or row.correlation_id != corr:
            return None
        return row.status if row.status in settled else None

    status, how = ctx.wait_for(what, claim_id, ready, corr)
    row = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
    return row, how


def decide(ctx, claim_id, stage, decision, remarks=""):
    from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.payer import driver

    record = driver.decide(ctx.claim(claim_id), stage, decision, remarks)
    ctx.decisions.append(record)
    read = record.get("read") or {}
    if record.get("skipped"):
        ctx.skip("payer desk reads the case", record["skipped"])
        ctx.skip(f"payer desk takes {decision}", record["skipped"])
        return record
    ctx.check(
        bool(read.get("role")),
        "payer desk reads the case",
        f"{read.get('caseNumber')}, {read.get('role')}, "
        f"{_case_view(read.get('response'))}"
        + (f", {read.get('error')}" if read.get("error") else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    ok = record.get("stopped") in {"decided", "completed"}
    trail = ", ".join(
        f"{s.get('action')} as {s.get('role')}"
        + ("" if s.get("success") else f" (refused: {s.get('error')})")
        for s in record.get("trail") or []
    )
    ctx.check(
        ok,
        f"payer desk takes {decision}",
        f"{record.get('stopped')}, {trail or record.get('error')}, cycle {record.get('cycle_id')}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    return record


def _case_view(response):
    if not isinstance(response, dict):
        return str(response)[:80]
    keep = ("id", "stage", "adjudication", "status", "claimed_amount")
    return ", ".join(f"{k} {response[k]}" for k in keep if response.get(k) is not None)


def prepare_irdai(ctx, *, rule_it=True, label=""):
    """A claim with the IRDAI policy, eligible, a plan line and its ruling."""
    claim_id, _policy = open_claim(ctx, "irdai", label=label)
    eligibility(ctx, claim_id, "validation")
    admit(ctx, claim_id)
    wait_plan(ctx, claim_id)
    code = first_package(ctx, claim_id)
    add_line(ctx, claim_id, code)
    if rule_it:
        rule(ctx, claim_id)
    fill_draft(ctx, claim_id)
    return claim_id


def approved_preauth(ctx, *, label=""):
    claim_id = prepare_irdai(ctx, label=label)
    row = submit_preauth(ctx, claim_id)
    decide(ctx, claim_id, "preauth", "approve", "e2e approval")
    row, how = wait_preauth(ctx, claim_id, row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status == "approved",
        "provider receives the approval",
        f"{row.status} by {how}, {row.approved_amount}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    return claim_id


def discharge(ctx, claim_id, stage="claim"):
    today = timezone.now().date().isoformat()
    ctx.send(
        "provider records the discharge",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/discharge/",
        {
            "discharge_mode": "normal",
            "discharge_stage": "After Surgery",
            "discharge_date": today,
            "surgery_date": today,
        },
    )


def submission_row(ctx, claim_id):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimSubmission

    return ClaimSubmission.objects.filter(claim__external_id=claim_id).first()


def submit_claim(ctx, claim_id, *, what="provider sends the claim", body=None):
    before = submission_row(ctx, claim_id)
    before_corr = before.correlation_id if before else None
    ctx.send(what, "POST", f"claims/{claim_id}/claim/submit/", body or {})
    row = submission_row(ctx, claim_id)
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status != "error" and bool(row.correlation_id) and row.correlation_id != before_corr,
        what,
        f"{row.submission_kind}, {row.status}, workflow {row.workflow_id}, "
        f"correlation {row.correlation_id}, preauth {row.preauth_ref or '-'}, "
        f"amount {row.requested_amount}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox" if "PAYR" in (row.error_message or "") else "ours",
    )
    return row


def wait_claim(ctx, claim_id, corr, *, what="provider receives the claim decision", settled=None):
    settled = settled or SETTLED_CLAIM

    def ready(k):
        row = submission_row(ctx, claim_id)
        if row is None or row.correlation_id != corr:
            return None
        return row.status if row.status in settled else None

    ctx.wait_for(what, claim_id, ready, corr)
    return submission_row(ctx, claim_id)

"""The CLI runner (T2L): runs scenarios in the application's process.

Every action goes through the application's own API views (the services the
screens use) with an in-process client signed in as the test operator; the
payer's side goes through the payer driver. Nothing here calls the gateway
over HTTP.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
import traceback
from datetime import datetime

from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

HTTP_OK = 200
HTTP_REDIRECT = 300
TICK = 3
POLL_EVERY = 10


class StepFailed(Exception):  # noqa: N818
    def __init__(self, what, got, cause="ours"):
        super().__init__(f"{what}: {got}")
        self.what, self.got, self.cause = what, got, cause


class Blocked(Exception):  # noqa: N818
    def __init__(self, detail, cause="sandbox", result="blocked"):
        super().__init__(detail)
        self.detail, self.cause, self.result = detail, cause, result


class Refused(Exception):  # noqa: N818
    def __init__(self, status, error, body):
        super().__init__(f"{status}: {error}")
        self.status, self.error, self.body = status, error, body


def _short(value, n=160) -> str:
    text = str(value)
    return text if len(text) <= n else text[: n - 1] + "…"


class Ctx:
    """One test attempt: its client, its claims, its steps and its record."""

    def __init__(self, conf, test_id, runner="cli", out=print):
        from care.facility.models import Facility
        from care.users.models import User

        self.conf = conf
        self.id = test_id
        self.runner = runner
        self.out = out
        self.facility = Facility.objects.get(external_id=conf.get("NHCX_TEST_FACILITY"))
        self.user = User.objects.get(username=conf.get("NHCX_TEST_USER"))
        self.doctor = User.objects.get(username=conf.get("NHCX_TEST_DOCTOR"))
        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)
        self.base = f"/api/v1/facility/{self.facility.external_id}/nhcx/"
        self.claims: list[str] = []
        self.correlation_ids: list[str] = []
        self.decisions: list[dict] = []
        self.steps: list[dict] = []
        self.skipped_checks: list[str] = []
        self.wait = conf.int("NHCX_TEST_WAIT_SECONDS")
        self.poll_after = conf.int("NHCX_TEST_POLL_AFTER_SECONDS")

    # ---- recording ----

    def step(self, what, got, result="pass"):
        at = timezone.localtime().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        self.steps.append(
            {"at": at, "what": what, "result": result, "got": _short(got, 400)}
        )
        self.out(f"{at} {self.id} {self.runner} {result.upper():4} {what:44} -> {_short(got)}")

    def fail(self, what, got, cause="ours"):
        self.step(what, got, "fail")
        raise StepFailed(what, got, cause)

    def check(self, ok, what, got, cause="ours"):
        if not ok:
            self.fail(what, got, cause)
        self.step(what, got)

    def skip(self, what, why):
        self.step(what, why, "skipped")
        self.skipped_checks.append(f"{what}: {why}")

    def corr(self, *ids):
        for c in ids:
            if c and c not in self.correlation_ids:
                self.correlation_ids.append(str(c))

    # ---- the application's API ----

    def api(self, method, path, data=None, *, multipart=False):
        url = self.base + path
        fn = getattr(self.client, method.lower())
        if multipart:
            resp = fn(url, data or {}, format="multipart")
        elif method.upper() == "GET":
            resp = fn(url, data or {})
        else:
            resp = fn(url, data or {}, format="json")
        body = getattr(resp, "data", None)
        if body is None:
            try:
                body = resp.json()
            except ValueError:
                body = {}
        if not HTTP_OK <= resp.status_code < HTTP_REDIRECT or (
            isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("ok") is False
        ):
            error = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else body
            raise Refused(resp.status_code, error or body, body)
        return body

    def send(self, what, method, path, data=None, *, multipart=False):
        """An action that must be accepted; a refusal fails the step."""
        try:
            return self.api(method, path, data, multipart=multipart)
        except Refused as e:
            cause = "sandbox" if _sandbox_text(e.error) else "ours"
            self.fail(what, f"refused {e.status}: {e.error}", cause)
        return None

    def state(self, claim_id) -> dict:
        return self.api("GET", f"claims/{claim_id}/state/")

    def claim(self, claim_id):
        from care.nhcx.models import Claim

        return Claim.objects.get(external_id=claim_id)

    # ---- waiting (T2X) ----

    def wait_for(self, what, claim_id, ready, corr=None, *, seconds=None):
        """Waits for ``ready(claim)`` (callbacks first, polls after a while).

        Returns (value, how) where how is "callback" or "poll".
        """
        seconds = seconds or self.wait
        start = time.monotonic()
        polled_at = None
        how = "callback"
        while True:
            claim = self.claim(claim_id)
            value = ready(claim)
            if value:
                return value, how
            elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
            if elapsed > seconds:
                c = corr(claim) if callable(corr) else corr
                ledger = ledger_ids(c)
                self.fail(
                    what,
                    f"nothing after {seconds}s; correlation {c or '-'}, "
                    f"ledger {', '.join(ledger) or '-'}",
                    "sandbox",
                )
            if elapsed > self.poll_after and (
                polled_at is None or time.monotonic() - polled_at > POLL_EVERY
            ):
                polled_at = time.monotonic()
                how = "poll"
                try:
                    self.state(claim_id)
                except Refused:
                    pass
            time.sleep(TICK)

    # ---- the report entry ----

    def entry(self, result, cause="", detail="", attempts=1) -> dict:
        ledger = []
        for c in self.correlation_ids:
            ledger += [i for i in ledger_ids(c) if i not in ledger]
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "runner": self.runner,
            "claim": ", ".join(self.claims),
            "correlation_ids": list(self.correlation_ids),
            "ledger_ids": ledger,
            "decisions": self.decisions,
            "steps": self.steps,
            "result": result,
            "cause": cause,
            "detail": detail,
            "attempts": attempts,
        }


SANDBOX_MARKERS = (
    "PAYR-",
    "NHCX-",
    "timed out",
    "unreachable",
    "the payer service returned 5",
    "Service Unavailable",
    "Bad Gateway",
)


def _sandbox_text(text) -> bool:
    return any(m.lower() in str(text).lower() for m in SANDBOX_MARKERS)


def ledger_ids(correlation_id) -> list:
    if not correlation_id:
        return []
    try:
        from care.nhcx.gateway import get_gateway

        thread = get_gateway().ledger.thread(str(correlation_id))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return []
    msgs = (thread or {}).get("messages") or []
    return [str(m.get("id") or m.get("api_call_id")) for m in msgs if m.get("id") or m.get("api_call_id")]


def run_one(conf, scenario, out=print, attempts_max=3):
    """Runs one scenario up to three times; returns its report entry."""
    entry = None
    for attempt in range(1, attempts_max + 1):
        ctx = Ctx(conf, scenario.id, "cli", out)
        retry = False
        try:
            scenario.run(ctx)
            if ctx.skipped_checks and not any(
                s["result"] == "fail" for s in ctx.steps
            ):
                entry = ctx.entry(
                    "pass",
                    detail="skipped checks: " + "; ".join(ctx.skipped_checks),
                    attempts=attempt,
                )
            else:
                entry = ctx.entry("pass", attempts=attempt)
        except Blocked as e:
            ctx.step("blocked", e.detail, e.result)
            entry = ctx.entry(e.result, e.cause, e.detail, attempt)
        except StepFailed as e:
            entry = ctx.entry("fail", e.cause, f"{e.what}: {e.got}", attempt)
            retry = e.cause == "sandbox"
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            tb = traceback.format_exc(limit=6)
            ctx.step("error", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "fail")
            entry = ctx.entry("fail", "ours", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}\n{tb}", attempt)
        if not retry or attempt == attempts_max:
            break
        out(f"{datetime.now():%H:%M:%S} {scenario.id} cli retry ({entry['detail'][:120]})")
    return entry

# NHCX application API contract (care backend <-> care_fe)

Base: `/api/v1/facility/{facility_id}/nhcx/` (facility external_id). Auth: normal CARE JWT; user must have access to the facility.
Claim ids (`{claim_id}`) are the claim's `external_id` UUID. All sending endpoints are `transaction.non_atomic_requests`.

Conventions
- Mutation success: `200 {"ok": true, "message": "<flash text or null>", "claim_id": "<uuid>"}` (+ extra keys noted).
- Refusal (spec's verbatim message): `400 {"ok": false, "error": "<message>"}`. FE shows it as a toast/inline alert, never as a crash.
- After any mutation FE refetches `state`.
- Rows in JSON use the D column names (as in the database/ specs) plus `id` = external_id.

## Owned by services-core (care/nhcx/api/views_core.py, urls in care/nhcx/api/urls.py)
| Method | Path | Spec | Body / query | Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `policy-search/` | A1, S1, S2, S17 | `{identifiertype, identifiervalue}` or `{abha_number, mobile, aadhaar}` | `{ok, policies:[{payer_id, payer_name, policy_number/policy_code, member_id, beneficiary_name, ...normalised}], message}` |
| POST | `claims/` | A1 open case, S2 | `{policy: <one policy object from search>, encounter?: uuid}` | `{ok, claim_id}` |
| GET | `claims/` | S5 | `?status=&stage=&search=&limit=&offset=` | `{count, results:[claim rows]}` |
| GET | `claims/{claim_id}/state/` | A17, S6 | — runs polls | A17 JSON (claim, plan, benefits, admissions, lines, ruling, ... poll_notes, next_send, enhancement_lines, required_documents, required_forms) |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/eligibility/` | A2, S3, S17 | `{purpose: validation|benefits|discovery, ...}` | ok/refusal |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/auth-requirements/` | A2 auth, S8.2 | `{}` (uses current lines) | ok/refusal |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/plan/` | A3, S7 | `{refresh?: bool}` | ok/refusal |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/lines/` | S8, D16 | `{kind, code, ..., quantity}` | ok + `line` |
| DELETE | `claims/{claim_id}/lines/{line_id}/` | S8 | | ok |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/admission/` | S4 link encounter | `{encounter: uuid}` | ok |
| GET | `ledger/` , `ledger/{id}/` | A13 (admin/debug) | | rows |

## Owned by services-legs (care/nhcx/api/views_legs.py, urls in care/nhcx/api/urls_legs.py, included by urls.py)
| Method | Path | Spec | Body |
|---|---|---|---|
| PUT | `claims/{claim_id}/draft/` | S4/S9 draft: diagnoses (D25), care_team (D26), items (D27), dates, form answers (D17) | partial object of those lists/fields |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/documents/` | D28 upload (multipart `file`, `code`, `category`, `stage`) | |
| DELETE | `claims/{claim_id}/documents/{doc_id}/` | D28 | |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/preauth/submit/` | A4 | `{kind?: request|enhancement|...}` |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/preauth/predetermination/` | A4 predetermination | |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/preauth/cancel/` | A6 cancel | `{reason, note}` |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/enquiry/` | A6 status/reprocess/release | `{action: status|reprocess|release, leg: preauth|claim, reason?, note?, amount?}` |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/claim/submit/` | A5, S11 | `{discharge_mode, discharge_date, ...}` |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/queries/{query_id}/reply/` | A7, S10 | `{text, document_ids:[]}` |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/payments/{payment_id}/ack/` | A8, S12 | |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/biometric/{init|verify|refresh}/` | A18, S18 | per A18 |
| POST | `claims/{claim_id}/adjudicate/` | A14/A15 (sandbox only; 404 when console off) | `{action, ...}` |
| GET/PUT | `profile/` | D1 FacilityProfile (hfr_id, participant_code, email, gstin) | |

## Outside facility scope
| Method | Path | Spec |
|---|---|---|
| GET/PUT | `/api/v1/nhcx/practitioner/{user_id}/` | D2 PractitionerProfile (hpr_id, qualification_code, specialty, department, active) — S16 |
| POST | `/api/v1/nhcx/abha/{action}/` | A19 server-side M1 flow: actions `aadhaar-otp`, `aadhaar-verify`, `mobile-otp`, `mobile-verify`, `profile`, `link` (sets PatientIdentifier on `{patient}`); returns `{txn_id, ...}` only, tokens stay server-side | S13-S15 |

## Shared hooks (A17)
`care/nhcx/services/hooks.py` (owned by services-core) exposes registries with defaults per A17D:
`next_send(claim, leg) `, `enhancement_lines(claim)`, `required_documents(claim, stage)`, `required_forms(claim, stage)`; services-legs registers real implementations via `hooks.register(name, fn)` at import (services/preauth.py, services/claim.py), and the AppConfig.ready imports those modules.

## C1 handler contract
`care.nhcx.callbacks.dispatch.receive(envelope, delivery) -> {"outcome": settled|unmatched|ignored|rejected|error, "detail": str}` (called by gateway G8; envelope = {meta, jwe_headers, fhir}; delivery = {path, type, flow, payload_kind, correlation_id, api_call_id, redelivery, participant}).
Dispatch (services-core) routes by path to handler modules exposing `handle(envelope, delivery) -> dict` with the same outcome shape:
- `coverageeligibility/on_check` -> callbacks/eligibility.py (C2, C3) [core]
- `insuranceplan/on_request` -> callbacks/plan.py (C4) [core]
- `preauth/on_submit` -> callbacks/preauth.py (C5) [legs]; `claim/on_submit` -> callbacks/claim.py (C6) [legs]
- `task/on_submit` -> callbacks/enquiry.py (C7 cancel + C8) [legs]
- `communication/request` -> callbacks/communication.py (C9) [legs]
- `paymentnotice/request` -> callbacks/payment.py (C10) [legs]
Polling (A10-A13, core) applies replies found in the ledger through the same `handle` functions.
Missing handler module => `unmatched`.

#### T9D. DESCRIPTION
A status enquiry and a cancel both go out as a Task ([A6. Task Submit (cancel, status, reprocess, release)](../apis/A6-task-submit.md)). The IRDAI test payer answers a status enquiry ([C8. Enquiry Reply](../callbacks/C8-enquiry-on-submit.md)) and a cancel ([C7. Cancel Reply](../callbacks/C7-cancel-on-submit.md)) on `v1/task/on_submit`; the correlation id decides which (CORE confusions).

Two claims with a pre-authorisation sent and still pending (no decision taken).

1. On the first claim, [S9. Pre-authorisation](../screens/S9-preauthorisation.md): ask for the status; wait for the answer.
2. On the second claim, [S9. Pre-authorisation](../screens/S9-preauthorisation.md): cancel the pre-authorisation with a reason; wait.
3. On the first claim, approve it through the payer driver, then try to cancel it on [S9. Pre-authorisation](../screens/S9-preauthorisation.md).
#### T9L. CLI
1. [A6. Task Submit (cancel, status, reprocess, release)](../apis/A6-task-submit.md) status on the first claim's leg; wait for [C8. Enquiry Reply](../callbacks/C8-enquiry-on-submit.md).

Pre-auth Reply](../callbacks/C5-preauth-on-submit.md), then [A6. Task Submit (cancel, status, reprocess, release)](../apis/A6-task-submit.md) cancel on it; wait for [C7. Cancel Reply](../callbacks/C7-cancel-on-submit.md).

- The status answer names the case's stage and is shown on [S9. Pre-authorisation](../screens/S9-preauthorisation.md) without changing the leg's status.

def packages(ctx, claim_id, n=2):
    row = ctx.claim(claim_id).plan
    codes = list(
        row.benefits.exclude(rate__isnull=True)
        .order_by("seq")
        .values_list("code", flat=True)
    )
    if len(codes) < n:
        raise Blocked(f"the plan lists {len(codes)} priced packages; {n} needed")
    return codes[:n]


def _handoff_path():
    from care.nhcx.tests.e2e import config as cfg

    return cfg.ARTIFACTS / "handoff.json"


def hand_over(key, claim_id):
    """Keeps a claim for a later test in the same run (T10 -> T11 -> T12)."""
    import json

    path = _handoff_path()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
    data[key] = claim_id
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2))


def taken_over(key):
    import json

    path = _handoff_path()
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
    return data.get(key)


# ---- queries, enquiries, cancels, payments ----


def wait_query(ctx, claim_id, after_id=0, *, what="question arrives (C9)"):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimQuery

    def ready(k):
        return (
            ClaimQuery.objects.filter(claim=k, id__gt=after_id).order_by("id").last()
        )

    row, how = ctx.wait_for(what, claim_id, ready)
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        bool(row.remarks or row.questions),
        what,
        f"{row.kind} by {how}, {row.status}, stage {row.stage}, "
        f"'{_text(row.remarks)}', correlation {row.correlation_id}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    return row


def _text(value, n=80):
    text = str(value or "")
    return text if len(text) <= n else text[: n - 1] + "…"


def last_query_id(claim_id):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimQuery

    row = ClaimQuery.objects.filter(claim__external_id=claim_id).order_by("id").last()
    return row.id if row else 0


def enquire(ctx, claim_id, body, *, what):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimEnquiry

    sent = ctx.send(what, "POST", f"claims/{claim_id}/enquiry/", body)
    row = ClaimEnquiry.objects.get(external_id=sent["enquiry_id"])
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status != "error",
        f"{what} goes out",
        f"{row.kind} on {row.stage}, {row.status}, correlation {row.correlation_id}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return row


def wait_enquiry(ctx, claim_id, row, *, what):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimEnquiry

    def ready(_k):
        r = ClaimEnquiry.objects.get(id=row.id)
        return r.status if r.status != "asking" else None

    status, how = ctx.wait_for(what, claim_id, ready, row.correlation_id)
    row = ClaimEnquiry.objects.get(id=row.id)
    ctx.check(
        status == "answered",
        what,
        f"{status} by {how}: {_text(row.answer)} {_text(row.detail)}"
        + (f", {row.error_message}" if row.error_message else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return row


def cancel_preauth(ctx, claim_id, *, reason="administrativeerror", note="e2e cancel"):
    ctx.send(
        "provider cancels the pre-authorisation",
        "POST",
        f"claims/{claim_id}/preauth/cancel/",
        {"reason": reason, "note": note},
    )
    row = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
    ctx.corr(row.cancel_correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        bool(row.cancel_correlation_id),
        "cancel goes out",
        f"{row.status} (was {row.pre_cancel_status}), "
        f"correlation {row.cancel_correlation_id}",
    )

    def ready(_k):
        r = preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
        return r.status if r.status != "cancelling" else None

    status, how = ctx.wait_for(
        "payer answers the cancel (C7)", claim_id, ready, row.cancel_correlation_id
    )
    return preauth_row(ctx, claim_id), how


def payments(claim_id):
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimPayment

    return list(ClaimPayment.objects.filter(claim__external_id=claim_id).order_by("id"))


def pay(ctx, claim_id, amount, utr):
    """Payer side: pays with a UTR; waits for C10 and the A8 acknowledgement."""
    from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.payer import driver

    before = len(payments(claim_id))
    record = driver.irdai_pay(ctx.claim(claim_id), amount, utr)
    ctx.decisions.append({"stage": "payment", **record})
    ctx.check(
        not record.get("error"),
        f"payer pays {amount} (UTR {utr})",
        f"case {record.get('case')}, HTTP {record.get('status')}"
        + (f", {record.get('error')}" if record.get("error") else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    rows, how = ctx.wait_for(
        "payment notice arrives (C10)",
        claim_id,
        lambda _k: payments(claim_id)[before:] or None,
    )
    row = rows[-1]
    ctx.corr(row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.utr == utr,
        "payment notice arrives (C10)",
        f"by {how}: {row.amount} UTR {row.utr}, {row.payment_status}, "
        f"correlation {row.correlation_id}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    from care.nhcx.models import ClaimPayment

    def acked(_k):
        r = ClaimPayment.objects.get(id=row.id)
        return r.ack_status if r.ack_status not in (None, "", "pending") else None

    try:
        ack, _how = ctx.wait_for("acknowledgement goes out (A8)", claim_id, acked, seconds=60)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        ack = None
    if not ack:
        ctx.send(
            "provider acknowledges the payment (A8)",
            "POST",
            f"claims/{claim_id}/payments/{row.external_id}/ack/",
            {},
        )
    row = ClaimPayment.objects.get(id=row.id)
    ctx.corr(row.ack_correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.ack_status not in (None, "", "error") and not row.ack_error,
        "acknowledgement goes out (A8)",
        f"{row.ack_status}, correlation {row.ack_correlation_id}"
        + (f", {row.ack_error}" if row.ack_error else ""),
        "sandbox",
    )
    return row
EOF

"""T6. IRDAI Pre-authorisation Rejected and Sent Again."""

from care.nhcx.services import adjudicator as adj
from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios import common as c

REMARK = "e2e: treatment not covered under the policy"


def run(ctx):
    claim_id = c.prepare_irdai(ctx)
    first = c.submit_preauth(ctx, claim_id)
    claim = ctx.claim(claim_id)
    calls = claim.adjudications.count()
    record = c.decide_refused(ctx, claim_id, "preauth", "reject", "")
    ctx.check(
        adj.IRDAI_REMARKS in (record.get("error") or "")
        and claim.adjudications.count() == calls,
        "reject without a remark is refused before any call",
        record.get("error"),
    )
    c.decide(ctx, claim_id, "preauth", "reject", REMARK)
    row, how = c.wait_preauth(ctx, claim_id, first.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status == "rejected",
        "first leg ends rejected (not queried)",
        f"{row.status} by {how}: {row.adjudication or row.disposition}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    second = c.submit_preauth(ctx, claim_id, what="provider sends it again")
    ctx.check(
        second.correlation_id != first.correlation_id,
        "second send travels on a new correlation id",
        f"{first.correlation_id} -> {second.correlation_id}",
    )
    c.decide(ctx, claim_id, "preauth", "approve", "e2e approval")
    row, how = c.wait_preauth(ctx, claim_id, second.correlation_id)
    history = [h.get("status") for h in (row.history or {}).get("legs", [])] if isinstance(
        row.history, dict
    ) else row.history
    ctx.check(
        row.status == "approved",
        "second send ends approved",
        f"{row.status} by {how}, approved {row.approved_amount}; history {str(history)[:120]}",
        "sandbox",
    )
EOF

from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios import common as c


def run(ctx):
    claim_id = c.approved_preauth(ctx)
    first = c.preauth_row(ctx, claim_id)
    original = first.approved_amount
    extra = c.packages(ctx, claim_id, 3)[1:]
    c.add_line(ctx, claim_id, extra[0])
    one = c.submit_preauth(ctx, claim_id, what="provider sends the enhancement")

        "enhancement goes out under its workflow on a new correlation id",
        f"{one.submission_kind}, workflow {one.workflow_id}, #{one.enhancement_no}",
    )
    c.decide(ctx, claim_id, "preauth", "approve", "e2e enhancement approved")
    row, how = c.wait_preauth(ctx, claim_id, one.correlation_id)
    raised = row.approved_amount
    ctx.check(
        row.status in {"approved", "partial"} and raised and raised > original,
        "approved enhancement raises the approved total",

"""T9. IRDAI Status Enquiry and Cancel."""

from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios import common as c


def run(ctx):
    first = c.prepare_irdai(ctx, label=" (first)")
    sent = c.submit_preauth(ctx, first)
    second = c.prepare_irdai(ctx, label=" (second)")
    c.submit_preauth(ctx, second)

    before = c.preauth_row(ctx, first).status
    asked = c.enquire(
        ctx,
        first,
        {"action": "status", "leg": "preauth", "note": "e2e status"},
        what="status enquiry on the first claim",
    )
    asked = c.wait_enquiry(ctx, first, asked, what="payer answers the status (C8)")
    after = c.preauth_row(ctx, first).status
    ctx.check(
        after == before,
        "status answer leaves the leg's status alone",
        f"{before} -> {after}; answer {asked.answer}",
    )

    row, how = c.cancel_preauth(ctx, second)
    ctx.check(
        row.status == "cancelled",
        "second leg ends cancelled",
        f"{row.status} by {how}",
        "sandbox",
    )

    c.decide(ctx, first, "preauth", "approve", "e2e approval")
    row, how = c.wait_preauth(ctx, first, sent.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(row.status == "approved", "first leg approved", f"{row.status} by {how}", "sandbox")
    row, how = c.cancel_preauth(ctx, first, note="e2e cancel after approval")
    if row.status == "approved":
        ctx.step(

            f"{row.status} by {how} (expected approved or cancelled)",
        )

"""T10. IRDAI Claim Approved, Part-approved and Rejected."""

from decimal import Decimal

from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios import common as c
from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.payer import driver


def _send(ctx, claim_id):
    c.discharge(ctx, claim_id)
    row = c.submit_claim(ctx, claim_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.submission_kind == "claim" and bool(row.preauth_ref),
        "claim goes out under the claim workflow, referring to its pre-auth",
        f"workflow {row.workflow_id}, preauth {row.preauth_ref}, {row.correlation_id}",
    )
    return row


def run(ctx):
    full = c.approved_preauth(ctx, label=" (approve)")
    row = _send(ctx, full)
    c.decide(ctx, full, "claim", "approve", "e2e claim approved")
    row = c.wait_claim(ctx, full, row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status == "approved" and row.approved_amount == row.requested_amount,
        "first claim approved for the claimed amount",
        f"{row.status}: {row.approved_amount} of {row.requested_amount}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    c.hand_over("irdai_claim_approved", full)

    part = c.approved_preauth(ctx, label=" (part)", lines=2)
    row = _send(ctx, part)
    case = driver.irdai_case(ctx.claim(part), "claim")
    lines = driver._line_items(case)  # noqa: SLF001
    ctx.check(len(lines) >= 2, "payer desk lists both claim lines", f"{len(lines)} lines on {case.get('id')}", "sandbox")
    first_amt = Decimal(str(lines[0].get("claimed_amount")))
    second_amt = Decimal(str(lines[1].get("claimed_amount")))
    allowed = (second_amt / 2).quantize(Decimal("1"))
    decided = driver.irdai_lines(
        ctx.claim(part),
        "claim",
        [("approved", float(first_amt)), ("partially_approved", float(allowed))],
    )
    ctx.decisions.append({"stage": "claim", "decision": "lines", **decided})
    ctx.check(
        all(d["error"] is None for d in decided["lines"]),
        "payer decides the lines",
        "; ".join(f"{d['code']} {d['decision']} {d['amount']} (HTTP {d['status']})" for d in decided["lines"]),
        "sandbox",
    )
    c.decide(ctx, part, "claim", "approve", "e2e claim part-approved")
    row = c.wait_claim(ctx, part, row.correlation_id)
    expect = first_amt + allowed
    ctx.check(
        row.status in {"approved", "partial"} and row.approved_amount == expect,
        "second claim approved at the sum of the allowed lines",
        f"{row.status}: {row.approved_amount} (expected {expect}) of {row.requested_amount}; "
        f"items {c.item_view(row)}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    c.hand_over("irdai_claim_partial", part)

    rejected = c.approved_preauth(ctx, label=" (reject)")
    row = _send(ctx, rejected)
    c.decide(ctx, rejected, "claim", "reject", "e2e: bills do not match the approval")
    row = c.wait_claim(ctx, rejected, row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(
        row.status == "rejected",
        "third claim rejected with its reason (outcome complete is not approval)",
        f"{row.status}, outcome {row.outcome}: {row.adjudication or row.disposition}",
        "sandbox",
    )
    c.hand_over("irdai_claim_rejected", rejected)
EOF

"""T11. IRDAI Payment Notice and Acknowledgement."""

import time

from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios import common as c


def run(ctx):
    claim_id = c.taken_over("irdai_claim_approved")
    if claim_id and c.submission_row(ctx, claim_id).status == "approved" and not c.payments(claim_id):
        ctx.claims.append(claim_id)
        ctx.step("claim approved at the claim stage", f"from T10: {ctx.claim(claim_id).claim_no}")
    else:
        claim_id = c.approved_preauth(ctx)
        c.discharge(ctx, claim_id)
        row = c.submit_claim(ctx, claim_id)
        c.decide(ctx, claim_id, "claim", "approve", "e2e claim approved")
        row = c.wait_claim(ctx, claim_id, row.correlation_id)
        ctx.check(row.status == "approved", "claim approved at the claim stage", row.status, "sandbox")
    approved = c.submission_row(ctx, claim_id).approved_amount
    first = (approved * 6 / 10).quantize(approved)
    stamp = int(time.time())
    one = c.pay(ctx, claim_id, float(first), f"E2EUTR{stamp}A")
    c.hand_over("irdai_claim_part_paid", claim_id)
    two = c.pay(ctx, claim_id, float(approved - first), f"E2EUTR{stamp}B")
    rows = c.payments(claim_id)
    total = sum((r.amount or 0) for r in rows)
    ctx.check(
        len(rows) == 2 and one.id != two.id and {r.utr for r in rows} == {one.utr, two.utr},
        "second instalment recorded beside the first",
        f"{len(rows)} payments, UTRs {[r.utr for r in rows]}, total {total} of {approved}",
    )
    state = ctx.state(claim_id)
    ctx.step(
        "claim shows paid once the instalments cover the approval",
        f"status {state.get('claim', {}).get('status')}, payments {len(state.get('payments') or [])}",
    )

"""T12. IRDAI Reprocess and Balance Release."""

import time

from care.nhcx.tests.e2e.scenarios import common as c


def _rejected_claim(ctx):
    claim_id = c.taken_over("irdai_claim_rejected")
    if claim_id and c.submission_row(ctx, claim_id).status == "rejected":
        ctx.claims.append(claim_id)
        ctx.step("claim rejected at the claim stage", f"from T10: {ctx.claim(claim_id).claim_no}")
        return claim_id
    claim_id = c.approved_preauth(ctx, label=" (rejected)")
    c.discharge(ctx, claim_id)
    row = c.submit_claim(ctx, claim_id)
    c.decide(ctx, claim_id, "claim", "reject", "e2e: bills do not match")
    row = c.wait_claim(ctx, claim_id, row.correlation_id)
    ctx.check(row.status == "rejected", "claim rejected at the claim stage", row.status, "sandbox")
    return claim_id


def _part_paid_claim(ctx):
    claim_id = c.taken_over("irdai_claim_part_paid") or c.taken_over("irdai_claim_partial")
    if claim_id:
        ctx.claims.append(claim_id)
        ctx.step(
            "claim paid (or approved) in part",
            f"from T10/T11: {ctx.claim(claim_id).claim_no}, {len(c.payments(claim_id))} payments",
        )
        return claim_id
    claim_id = c.approved_preauth(ctx, label=" (part paid)")
    c.discharge(ctx, claim_id)
    row = c.submit_claim(ctx, claim_id)
    c.decide(ctx, claim_id, "claim", "approve", "e2e")
    row = c.wait_claim(ctx, claim_id, row.correlation_id)
    c.pay(ctx, claim_id, float(row.approved_amount / 2), f"E2EUTR{int(time.time())}P")
    return claim_id


def run(ctx):
    rejected = _rejected_claim(ctx)
    sent = c.submission_row(ctx, rejected)
    asked = c.enquire(
        ctx,
        rejected,
        {
            "action": "reprocess",
            "leg": "claim",
            "reason_code": "claimrejected",
            "reason": "claimrejected",
            "note": "e2e: corrected bills attached",
        },
        what="reprocess on the rejected claim",
    )
    c.wait_enquiry(ctx, rejected, asked, what="payer acknowledges the reprocess (C8)")
    c.decide(ctx, rejected, "claim", "approve", "e2e approved on reprocess")

    def ready(_k):
        row = c.submission_row(ctx, rejected)
        return row.status if row.status in {"approved", "partial"} else None

    status, how = ctx.wait_for("claim approved again (C6)", rejected, ready, sent.correlation_id)
    row = c.submission_row(ctx, rejected)
    ctx.check(
        status == "approved",
        "claim approved again, rejection kept in its history",
        f"{status} by {how}, {row.approved_amount}; history {c.preauth_history(row)}",
        "sandbox",
    )

    part = _part_paid_claim(ctx)
    asked = c.enquire(
        ctx,
        part,
        {
            "action": "release",
            "leg": "claim",
            "reason_code": "partialpayment",
            "reason": "partialpayment",
            "note": "e2e: balance pending",
        },
        what="balance release on the partly paid claim",
    )
    c.wait_enquiry(ctx, part, asked, what="payer acknowledges the release (C8)")
